Rating notch calculator + country rating change indicator (Watchlist POC slice)

Source: POC_Requirements_v0.2_EN.md (Corporate Client Credit Monitoring — Watchlist Tool).
This job is a 2-requirement slice of that document. Build only these two requirements.

## Requirements (verbatim from the POC)

| Req ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria (summary) |
|---|---|---|
| REQ-06-02 | A notch calculator helper shall be available: analyst selects previous rating and current rating → system outputs notch change and resultant WL | BBB+ → BB+ = 2 notch downgrade → WL=1 displayed |
| REQ-03-12 | Indicator 12 (Country rating change): Pre-filled from public source; notch change auto-calculated | 1 notch → WL=1; 2+ notches → WL=2; auto-filled value editable |

Related rule (REQ-03-13, Indicator 13 — external rating change): 2 notch downgrade → WL=1; 3+ notches → WL=2.

## Clarifications for this slice (confirmed by the business unit)

- C1. Rating scale, best to worst (19 steps): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-.
  A notch is one step on this scale. Input is trimmed and case-insensitive ("bbb+" = "BBB+"); anything else is rejected with a RangeError.
- C2. The POC example for REQ-06-02 miscounts: BBB+ → BB+ is 3 notches (BBB+ → BBB → BBB- → BB+). The calculator's WL uses the
  Indicator 13 thresholds (2 notches → WL=1, 3+ → WL=2), so BBB+ → BB+ = 3-notch downgrade → WL=2, and BBB+ → BBB- = 2 notches → WL=1.
- C3. Upgrades and unchanged ratings → WL=0 for both indicators.
- C4. Fetching the rating from a public source is OUT of scope for this slice; the indicator takes the previous and current rating as input.
- C6. A 1-notch downgrade gives calculator WL 0 (Indicator 13 starts at 2 notches); Indicator 12 is unaffected (1 notch → WL 1).
- C7. "Auto-filled value editable" (REQ-03-12) is met by the contract: the caller passes whichever previous/current rating the
  analyst confirmed or edited. No override parameter, no persistence and no audit trail in this slice.
- C8. "Displayed" (REQ-06-02) is met by the returned `{ notches, direction, wl }`: the screens of the POC are built later
  by other parts and render this value. No UI, CLI or printed output in this slice.

## Contract (other parts of the POC will import exactly these)

- `src/ratings/notch.mjs`
  - `RATING_SCALE` — the 19 ratings of C1, best first.
  - `notchChange(previous, current)` → integer; positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged.
  - `notchCalculator(previous, current)` → `{ notches, direction: "downgrade" | "upgrade" | "unchanged", wl }` (wl per C2/C3).
- `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs`
  - `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)` → 0 | 1 | 2 (REQ-03-12 thresholds, C3), built on `notchChange`.

Plain Node ESM, no dependencies; tests with `node --test` next to the code under `test/`.

Source: POC_Requirements_v0.2_EN.md (Corporate Client Credit Monitoring — Watchlist Tool).
This job is a 2-requirement slice of that document. Build only these two requirements.

## Requirements (verbatim from the POC)

| Req ID | Requirement | Acceptance Criteria (summary) |
|---|---|---|
| REQ-06-02 | A notch calculator helper shall be available: analyst selects previous rating and current rating → system outputs notch change and resultant WL | BBB+ → BB+ = 2 notch downgrade → WL=1 displayed |
| REQ-03-12 | Indicator 12 (Country rating change): Pre-filled from public source; notch change auto-calculated | 1 notch → WL=1; 2+ notches → WL=2; auto-filled value editable |

Related rule (REQ-03-13, Indicator 13 — external rating change): 2 notch downgrade → WL=1; 3+ notches → WL=2.

## Clarifications for this slice (confirmed by the business unit)

- C1. Rating scale, best to worst (19 steps): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-.
  A notch is one step on this scale. Input is trimmed and case-insensitive ("bbb+" = "BBB+"); anything else is rejected with a RangeError.
- C2. The POC example for REQ-06-02 miscounts: BBB+ → BB+ is 3 notches (BBB+ → BBB → BBB- → BB+). The calculator's WL uses the
  Indicator 13 thresholds (2 notches → WL=1, 3+ → WL=2), so BBB+ → BB+ = 3-notch downgrade → WL=2, and BBB+ → BBB- = 2 notches → WL=1.
- C3. Upgrades and unchanged ratings → WL=0 for both indicators.
- C4. Fetching the rating from a public source is OUT of scope for this slice; the indicator takes the previous and current rating as input.
- C6. A 1-notch downgrade gives calculator WL 0 (Indicator 13 starts at 2 notches); Indicator 12 is unaffected (1 notch → WL 1).
- C7. "Auto-filled value editable" (REQ-03-12) is met by the contract: the caller passes whichever previous/current rating the
  analyst confirmed or edited. No override parameter, no persistence and no audit trail in this slice.
- C8. "Displayed" (REQ-06-02) is met by the returned `{ notches, direction, wl }`: the screens of the POC are built later
  by other parts and render this value. No UI, CLI or printed output in this slice.

## Contract (other parts of the POC will import exactly these)

- `src/ratings/notch.mjs`
  - `RATING_SCALE` — the 19 ratings of C1, best first.
  - `notchChange(previous, current)` → integer; positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged.
  - `notchCalculator(previous, current)` → `{ notches, direction: "downgrade" | "upgrade" | "unchanged", wl }` (wl per C2/C3).
- `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs`
  - `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)` → 0 | 1 | 2 (REQ-03-12 thresholds, C3), built on `notchChange`.

Plain Node ESM, no dependencies; tests with `node --test` next to the code under `test/`.

# Plan

## Goal
Deliver the two Watchlist POC requirements of this slice as pure Node ESM library functions that other POC parts will import:
- **REQ-06-02**, the notch calculator helper. The analyst gives a previous and a current rating, and gets back the notch change and the resulting WL (Indicator 13 thresholds, per C2, C3 and C6).
- **REQ-03-12**, Indicator 12 (country rating change). It returns WL 0, 1 or 2 from the notch change between the previous and current country rating (C3, C6, C7).

Success means:
- The four contract exports exist with exactly the names and meanings in the request's Contract section and in readiness.
- Every AC below passes under `node --test`.

## Scope
- `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports:
  - `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 C1 ratings, best first, frozen (X-scale-shape).
  - `notchChange(previous, current)`: a signed integer. Positive means downgrade, negative means upgrade, 0 means unchanged.
  - `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: returns `{ notches, direction, wl }`.
    - `notches` has the same sign as `notchChange` (CON-interface, decided by the human).
    - `wl` uses the Indicator 13 thresholds (X-wl-rules).
- `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)`. It returns 0, 1 or 2, and is built on `notchChange` (imported from `../ratings/notch.mjs`).
- Input validation on all three functions. Input is trimmed and matched case-insensitively against the C1 scale. Anything else throws `RangeError` (C1, CON-errors).
- Dev unit tests in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs`.
- QA integration tests through the public exports under `test/integration/ratings/` and `test/integration/indicators/` (TST-strategy).
- Tests use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.

## Out of scope
- Fetching or pre-filling the country rating from a public source (C4).
- An override parameter, persistence or an audit trail for analyst edits (C7, NFR-audit).
- Any UI, CLI, printed or logged output (C8, NFR-observability).
- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export. Its thresholds live only inside `notchCalculator().wl` (X-ind13-scope).
- Any other POC requirement or indicator (Ind. 1–11, 13 as an indicator).
- Rating notations other than the 19 C1 grades, such as Moody's `Baa1`, `D`, `NR` or `SD`. These are rejected, not mapped.
- npm dependencies, TypeScript, linting and docs or changelog work (ARC-stack, DEL-docs).
- The exact text of the RangeError message. Only the error type is contract (X-error-message).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1 (C1, Contract):** Given `src/ratings/notch.mjs`, when `RATING_SCALE` is imported, then:
  - it deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]`, with length 19 and best first;
  - `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true` (X-scale-shape);
  - in a non-strict assignment `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"`, it still reads `"AAA"` afterwards.

- **AC-2 (REQ-06-02, C1, C2, Contract):** Given two valid ratings, when `notchChange(previous, current)` is called, then it returns the signed step distance `index(current) − index(previous)` on `RATING_SCALE`:

  | previous | current | result |
  |---|---|---|
  | BBB+ | BB+ | 3 |
  | BBB+ | BBB- | 2 |
  | BBB+ | BBB | 1 |
  | BB+ | BBB+ | -3 |
  | BBB | BBB+ | -1 |
  | AAA | CCC- | 18 |
  | CCC- | AAA | -18 |
  | A | A | 0 |

  For `A` → `A`, `Object.is(result, 0)` is true (not `-0`). Every result is `Number.isInteger`.

- **AC-3 (C1):** Given input that is a valid grade with extra whitespace or different case, when it is passed to `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` or `countryRatingChangeWl`, then it is treated as the canonical grade:
  - `notchChange(" bbb+ ", "BB+") === 3`
  - `notchChange("aaa", "Ccc-") === 18`
  - `notchChange("\tBb+\n", "bbb+") === -3`
  - `notchCalculator("bbb+", " bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
  - `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+", "bbb ") === 1`

- **AC-4 (C1, CON-errors, X-error-message):** Given an invalid value in either the `previous` or the `current` position (the other argument being `"BBB"`), when `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` or `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it throws an error that is `instanceof RangeError`. No value is returned and there is no fallback. The invalid values are:
  - `""` and `"   "`
  - `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`
  - `"BBB +"` (inner space) and `"BBB−"` (Unicode minus U+2212)
  - `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`
  - a missing argument, e.g. `notchChange("BBB")`

  Tests check only the error type, not the message text.

- **AC-5 (REQ-06-02, C2):** Given previous `"BBB+"` and current `"BB+"`, when `notchCalculator` is called, then it returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`. This is the corrected POC example: a 3-notch downgrade gives WL 2, not "2 notches, WL 1".

- **AC-6 (REQ-06-02, C2):** Given previous `"BBB+"` and current `"BBB-"`, when `notchCalculator` is called, then it returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.

- **AC-7 (REQ-06-02, C6):** Given previous `"BBB+"` and current `"BBB"` (a 1-notch downgrade), when `notchCalculator` is called, then it returns `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`.

- **AC-8 (REQ-06-02, C2):** Given a downgrade of 3 or more notches, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `wl` is 2:
  - `"AAA"` → `"CCC-"` returns `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
  - `"A"` → `"BBB+"` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` (boundary check)
  - `"A"` → `"BBB"` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`

- **AC-9 (REQ-06-02, C3, CON-interface):** Given an upgrade, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `notches` is negative and equals `notchChange`, `direction` is `"upgrade"` and `wl` is 0:
  - `"BB"` → `"BBB"` returns `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`
  - `"BBB"` → `"BBB+"` returns `{ notches: -1, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`
  - `"CCC-"` → `"AAA"` returns `{ notches: -18, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`

- **AC-10 (REQ-06-02, C3):** Given the same rating twice, when `notchCalculator` is called, then the result is "unchanged" with WL 0:
  - `"A"` → `"A"` returns `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }`, and `Object.is(notches, 0)` is true;
  - `" a"` → `"A "` gives the same result.

- **AC-11 (REQ-06-02, C8, X-scale-shape):** Given any valid pair, when `notchCalculator` is called, then:
  - the result is a plain object whose only keys are `notches`, `direction` and `wl`;
  - `direction` is one of `"downgrade"`, `"upgrade"` or `"unchanged"`;
  - `wl` is one of 0, 1 or 2;
  - the result is returned synchronously (not a Promise);
  - each call returns a new object: after `r1 = notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+"); r1.wl = 99`, the call `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+").wl === 2`.

- **AC-12 (REQ-03-12, C6):** Given a 1-notch downgrade, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it returns 1:
  - `("BBB+","BBB") → 1`
  - `("CCC","CCC-") → 1`
  - `("AAA","AA+") → 1`

- **AC-13 (REQ-03-12):** Given a downgrade of 2 or more notches, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it returns 2:
  - `("BBB+","BBB-") → 2`
  - `("BBB+","BB+") → 2`
  - `("AAA","CCC-") → 2`

- **AC-14 (REQ-03-12, C3):** Given an upgrade or an unchanged rating, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it returns 0:
  - `("BBB","BBB+") → 0`
  - `("BB+","BBB+") → 0`
  - `("CCC-","AAA") → 0`
  - `("A","A") → 0`

- **AC-15 (REQ-03-12, C7, C4):** Given that the country rating was pre-filled as `"BBB"` and the analyst edited it to `"BB+"`, when the caller passes the confirmed values `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+", "BB+")`, then it returns 2, i.e. the edited value is used. In addition:
  - the function takes exactly two arguments (`countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2`);
  - it has no override parameter;
  - it does no network, file or console I/O;
  - it returns a number synchronously.

- **AC-16 (REQ-06-02, REQ-03-12, X-wl-rules, Contract "built on notchChange"):** Given all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` from `RATING_SCALE`, with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, when all three functions are called, then for every pair:
  - `notchCalculator(p,c).notches === d`;
  - `direction` is `"downgrade"` when `d > 0`, `"upgrade"` when `d < 0` and `"unchanged"` when `d === 0`;
  - `notchCalculator(p,c).wl` is 0 when `d ≤ 1`, 1 when `d = 2` and 2 when `d ≥ 3`;
  - `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is 0 when `d ≤ 0`, 1 when `d = 1` and 2 when `d ≥ 2`.

- **AC-17 (Contract, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md):** Given the delivered repository, then:
  - `Object.keys(await import("src/ratings/notch.mjs")).sort()` equals `["RATING_SCALE","notchCalculator","notchChange"]`;
  - `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports exactly `["countryRatingChangeWl"]` and imports `notchChange` from `../ratings/notch.mjs`;
  - neither file imports any `node:` I/O module (fs, http, net, child_process) or writes to the console;
  - `package.json` has no `dependencies` or `devDependencies`;
  - `node --test` exits with code 0.

## Risks and assumptions
- **The POC example is wrong (resolved).** REQ-06-02's example "BBB+ → BB+ = 2 notch downgrade → WL=1" contradicts the C1 scale. Following C2, the plan takes 3 notches and WL 2 (AC-5). Anyone checking against the raw POC text will see this difference. It is intentional.
- **Two threshold sets on purpose.** The calculator uses the Indicator 13 thresholds and Indicator 12 uses its own, so a 1-notch downgrade gives calculator WL 0 but Indicator 12 WL 1 (C6, AC-7 vs AC-12). The risk is that a developer reuses one mapping for both. AC-16 catches this across all 361 pairs.
- **Sign of `notches`.** The request did not specify it (C5 was removed). The human decided it in readiness (CON-interface): signed like `notchChange`, so upgrades are negative. AC-9 and AC-16 pin it.
- **`-0` risk.** A computation like `-(a - b)` can produce `-0` for unchanged ratings. AC-2 and AC-10 require `+0`, checked with `Object.is`.
- **Assumption: whitespace.** "Trimmed" means `String.prototype.trim()`, which removes all leading and trailing whitespace including tab and newline (AC-3). Inner whitespace is not removed (`"BBB +"` is rejected, AC-4).
- **Assumption: non-primitive strings.** A boxed string such as `new String("BBB")` is not a primitive string and is rejected with `RangeError` ("anything else", C1, CON-errors). This is not part of the ACs. It is noted so dev and QA do not disagree about it.
- **Assumption: error order.** When both arguments are invalid, `previous` is validated first (X-error-message). Only the error type is contract, so no AC depends on the order.
- **Node version.** CLAUDE.md requires Node 18+; the sandbox runs Node v22.22.0. Test files must follow the `*.test.mjs` naming under `test/` so that `node --test` without arguments finds them on both versions.

## Open questions
None. Every item that changes scope or behaviour was settled in readiness.md: the notches sign by the human (CON-interface), and error and shape details by the PM (X-error-message, X-scale-shape).

# Plan

## Goal
Deliver the two Watchlist POC requirements of this slice as pure Node ESM library functions that other POC parts will import:
- **REQ-06-02**, the notch calculator helper. The analyst gives a previous and a current rating, and gets back the notch change and the resulting WL (Indicator 13 thresholds, per C2, C3 and C6).
- **REQ-03-12**, Indicator 12 (country rating change). It returns WL 0, 1 or 2 from the notch change between the previous and current country rating (C3, C6, C7).

Success means:
- The four contract exports exist with exactly the names and meanings in the request's Contract section and in readiness.
- Every AC below passes under `node --test`.

## Scope
- `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports:
  - `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 C1 ratings, best first, frozen (X-scale-shape).
  - `notchChange(previous, current)`: a signed integer. Positive means downgrade, negative means upgrade, 0 means unchanged.
  - `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: returns `{ notches, direction, wl }`.
    - `notches` has the same sign as `notchChange` (CON-interface, decided by the human).
    - `wl` uses the Indicator 13 thresholds (X-wl-rules).
- `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)`. It returns 0, 1 or 2, and is built on `notchChange` (imported from `../ratings/notch.mjs`).
- Input validation on all three functions. Input is trimmed and matched case-insensitively against the C1 scale. Anything else throws `RangeError` (C1, CON-errors).
- Dev unit tests in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs`.
- QA integration tests through the public exports under `test/integration/ratings/` and `test/integration/indicators/` (TST-strategy).
- Tests use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.

## Out of scope
- Fetching or pre-filling the country rating from a public source (C4).
- An override parameter, persistence or an audit trail for analyst edits (C7, NFR-audit).
- Any UI, CLI, printed or logged output (C8, NFR-observability).
- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export. Its thresholds live only inside `notchCalculator().wl` (X-ind13-scope).
- Any other POC requirement or indicator (Ind. 1–11, 13 as an indicator).
- Rating notations other than the 19 C1 grades, such as Moody's `Baa1`, `D`, `NR` or `SD`. These are rejected, not mapped.
- npm dependencies, TypeScript, linting and docs or changelog work (ARC-stack, DEL-docs).
- The exact text of the RangeError message. Only the error type is contract (X-error-message).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1 (C1, Contract):** Given `src/ratings/notch.mjs`, when `RATING_SCALE` is imported, then:
  - it deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]`, with length 19 and best first;
  - `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true` (X-scale-shape);
  - in a non-strict assignment `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"`, it still reads `"AAA"` afterwards.

- **AC-2 (REQ-06-02, C1, C2, Contract):** Given two valid ratings, when `notchChange(previous, current)` is called, then it returns the signed step distance `index(current) − index(previous)` on `RATING_SCALE`:

  | previous | current | result |
  |---|---|---|
  | BBB+ | BB+ | 3 |
  | BBB+ | BBB- | 2 |
  | BBB+ | BBB | 1 |
  | BB+ | BBB+ | -3 |
  | BBB | BBB+ | -1 |
  | AAA | CCC- | 18 |
  | CCC- | AAA | -18 |
  | A | A | 0 |

  For `A` → `A`, `Object.is(result, 0)` is true (not `-0`). Every result is `Number.isInteger`.

- **AC-3 (C1):** Given input that is a valid grade with extra whitespace or different case, when it is passed to `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` or `countryRatingChangeWl`, then it is treated as the canonical grade:
  - `notchChange(" bbb+ ", "BB+") === 3`
  - `notchChange("aaa", "Ccc-") === 18`
  - `notchChange("\tBb+\n", "bbb+") === -3`
  - `notchCalculator("bbb+", " bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
  - `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+", "bbb ") === 1`

- **AC-4 (C1, CON-errors, X-error-message):** Given an invalid value in either the `previous` or the `current` position (the other argument being `"BBB"`), when `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` or `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it throws an error that is `instanceof RangeError`. No value is returned and there is no fallback. The invalid values are:
  - `""` and `"   "`
  - `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`
  - `"BBB +"` (inner space) and `"BBB−"` (Unicode minus U+2212)
  - `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`
  - a missing argument, e.g. `notchChange("BBB")`

  Tests check only the error type, not the message text.

- **AC-5 (REQ-06-02, C2):** Given previous `"BBB+"` and current `"BB+"`, when `notchCalculator` is called, then it returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`. This is the corrected POC example: a 3-notch downgrade gives WL 2, not "2 notches, WL 1".

- **AC-6 (REQ-06-02, C2):** Given previous `"BBB+"` and current `"BBB-"`, when `notchCalculator` is called, then it returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.

- **AC-7 (REQ-06-02, C6):** Given previous `"BBB+"` and current `"BBB"` (a 1-notch downgrade), when `notchCalculator` is called, then it returns `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`.

- **AC-8 (REQ-06-02, C2):** Given a downgrade of 3 or more notches, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `wl` is 2:
  - `"AAA"` → `"CCC-"` returns `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
  - `"A"` → `"BBB+"` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` (boundary check)
  - `"A"` → `"BBB"` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`

- **AC-9 (REQ-06-02, C3, CON-interface):** Given an upgrade, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `notches` is negative and equals `notchChange`, `direction` is `"upgrade"` and `wl` is 0:
  - `"BB"` → `"BBB"` returns `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`
  - `"BBB"` → `"BBB+"` returns `{ notches: -1, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`
  - `"CCC-"` → `"AAA"` returns `{ notches: -18, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`

- **AC-10 (REQ-06-02, C3):** Given the same rating twice, when `notchCalculator` is called, then the result is "unchanged" with WL 0:
  - `"A"` → `"A"` returns `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }`, and `Object.is(notches, 0)` is true;
  - `" a"` → `"A "` gives the same result.

- **AC-11 (REQ-06-02, C8, X-scale-shape):** Given any valid pair, when `notchCalculator` is called, then:
  - the result is a plain object whose only keys are `notches`, `direction` and `wl`;
  - `direction` is one of `"downgrade"`, `"upgrade"` or `"unchanged"`;
  - `wl` is one of 0, 1 or 2;
  - the result is returned synchronously (not a Promise);
  - each call returns a new object: after `r1 = notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+"); r1.wl = 99`, the call `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+").wl === 2`.

- **AC-12 (REQ-03-12, C6):** Given a 1-notch downgrade, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it returns 1:
  - `("BBB+","BBB") → 1`
  - `("CCC","CCC-") → 1`
  - `("AAA","AA+") → 1`

- **AC-13 (REQ-03-12):** Given a downgrade of 2 or more notches, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it returns 2:
  - `("BBB+","BBB-") → 2`
  - `("BBB+","BB+") → 2`
  - `("AAA","CCC-") → 2`

- **AC-14 (REQ-03-12, C3):** Given an upgrade or an unchanged rating, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it returns 0:
  - `("BBB","BBB+") → 0`
  - `("BB+","BBB+") → 0`
  - `("CCC-","AAA") → 0`
  - `("A","A") → 0`

- **AC-15 (REQ-03-12, C7, C4):** Given that the country rating was pre-filled as `"BBB"` and the analyst edited it to `"BB+"`, when the caller passes the confirmed values `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+", "BB+")`, then it returns 2, i.e. the edited value is used. In addition:
  - the function takes exactly two arguments (`countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2`);
  - it has no override parameter;
  - it does no network, file or console I/O;
  - it returns a number synchronously.

- **AC-16 (REQ-06-02, REQ-03-12, X-wl-rules, Contract "built on notchChange"):** Given all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` from `RATING_SCALE`, with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, when all three functions are called, then for every pair:
  - `notchCalculator(p,c).notches === d`;
  - `direction` is `"downgrade"` when `d > 0`, `"upgrade"` when `d < 0` and `"unchanged"` when `d === 0`;
  - `notchCalculator(p,c).wl` is 0 when `d ≤ 1`, 1 when `d = 2` and 2 when `d ≥ 3`;
  - `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is 0 when `d ≤ 0`, 1 when `d = 1` and 2 when `d ≥ 2`.

- **AC-17 (Contract, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md):** Given the delivered repository, then:
  - `Object.keys(await import("src/ratings/notch.mjs")).sort()` equals `["RATING_SCALE","notchCalculator","notchChange"]`;
  - `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports exactly `["countryRatingChangeWl"]` and imports `notchChange` from `../ratings/notch.mjs`;
  - neither file imports any `node:` I/O module (fs, http, net, child_process) or writes to the console;
  - `package.json` has no `dependencies` or `devDependencies`;
  - `node --test` exits with code 0.

1	# Plan
2	
3	## Goal
4	Deliver the two Watchlist POC requirements of this slice as pure Node ESM library functions that other POC parts will import:
5	- **REQ-06-02**, the notch calculator helper: previous + current rating -> notch change and resulting WL (Indicator 13 thresholds, C2, C3, C6).
6	- **REQ-03-12**, Indicator 12 (country rating change): WL 0, 1 or 2 from the notch change (C3, C6, C7).
7	
8	Success: the four contract exports exist with the exact names and meanings of the Contract section and readiness; every AC below passes under `node --test`.
9	
10	## Scope
11	- `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports:
12	  - `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 C1 ratings, best first, frozen (X-scale-shape).
13	  - `notchChange(previous, current)`: signed integer, positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged.
14	  - `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: `{ notches, direction, wl }`; `notches` signed like `notchChange` (CON-interface, human decision); `wl` per Indicator 13 thresholds (X-wl-rules).
15	- `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)` -> 0 | 1 | 2, built on `notchChange` (imported from `../ratings/notch.mjs`).
16	- Input validation on all three functions: trimmed, case-insensitive match against the C1 scale; anything else throws `RangeError` (C1, CON-errors).
17	- Dev unit tests in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs`.
18	- QA integration tests through the public exports under `test/integration/ratings/` and `test/integration/indicators/` (TST-strategy).
19	- Tests use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.
20	
21	## Out of scope
22	- Fetching or pre-filling the country rating from a public source (C4).
23	- Override parameter, persistence or audit trail for analyst edits (C7, NFR-audit).
24	- Any UI, CLI, printed or logged output (C8, NFR-observability).
25	- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export; its thresholds live only inside `notchCalculator().wl` (X-ind13-scope).
26	- Any other POC requirement or indicator.
27	- Rating notations other than the 19 C1 grades (`Baa1`, `D`, `NR`, `SD`): rejected, not mapped.
28	- npm dependencies, TypeScript, linting, docs or changelog work (ARC-stack, DEL-docs).
29	- The exact RangeError message text; only the type is contract (X-error-message).
30	
31	## Acceptance criteria
32	
33	- **AC-1 (C1, Contract):** `RATING_SCALE` deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]` (length 19, best first); `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true` (X-scale-shape); a non-strict assignment `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` leaves `"AAA"`.
34	
35	- **AC-2 (REQ-06-02, C1, C2, Contract):** `notchChange(previous, current)` returns `index(current) - index(previous)` on `RATING_SCALE`:
36	
37	  | previous | current | result |
38	  |---|---|---|
39	  | BBB+ | BB+ | 3 |
40	  | BBB+ | BBB- | 2 |
41	  | BBB+ | BBB | 1 |
42	  | BB+ | BBB+ | -3 |
43	  | BBB | BBB+ | -1 |
44	  | AAA | CCC- | 18 |
45	  | CCC- | AAA | -18 |
46	  | A | A | 0 |
47	
48	  For A -> A, `Object.is(result, 0)` (not `-0`). Every result is an integer.
49	
50	- **AC-3 (C1):** Valid grades with extra whitespace or different case are treated as canonical in `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl`:
51	  - `notchChange(" bbb+ ", "BB+") === 3`
52	  - `notchChange("aaa", "Ccc-") === 18`
53	  - `notchChange("\tBb+\n", "bbb+") === -3`
54	  - `notchCalculator("bbb+", " bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
55	  - `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+", "bbb ") === 1`
56	
57	- **AC-4 (C1, CON-errors, X-error-message):** An invalid value in either the `previous` or the `current` position (the other being `"BBB"`) makes `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`; no fallback. Invalid values: `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"` (U+2212), `null`, `undefined`, `3`, `{}`, and a missing argument (`notchChange("BBB")`). Tests check only the error type.
58	
59	- **AC-5 (REQ-06-02, C2):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` (the corrected POC example).
60	
61	- **AC-6 (REQ-06-02, C2):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB-")` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.
62	
63	- **AC-7 (REQ-06-02, C6):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB")` returns `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`.
64	
65	- **AC-8 (REQ-06-02, C2):** A downgrade of 3+ notches gives `wl` 2: `"AAA"->"CCC-"` returns `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`; `"A"->"BBB+"` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` (boundary); `"A"->"BBB"` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.
66	
67	- **AC-9 (REQ-06-02, C3, CON-interface):** An upgrade gives negative `notches` equal to `notchChange`, `direction` `"upgrade"`, `wl` 0: `"BB"->"BBB"` -> `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`; `"BBB"->"BBB+"` -> `{ notches: -1, ... }`; `"CCC-"->"AAA"` -> `{ notches: -18, ... }`.
68	
69	- **AC-10 (REQ-06-02, C3):** The same rating twice: `"A"->"A"` returns `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }` with `Object.is(notches, 0)`; `" a"->"A "` gives the same.
70	
71	- **AC-11 (REQ-06-02, C8, X-scale-shape):** For any valid pair `notchCalculator` returns a plain object whose only keys are `notches`, `direction`, `wl`; `direction` is one of the three words; `wl` is 0, 1 or 2; it is synchronous; each call returns a new object (mutating `r1.wl` does not affect the next call).
72	
73	- **AC-12 (REQ-03-12, C6):** A 1-notch downgrade gives 1: `("BBB+","BBB")`, `("CCC","CCC-")`, `("AAA","AA+")`.
74	
75	- **AC-13 (REQ-03-12):** A downgrade of 2+ notches gives 2: `("BBB+","BBB-")`, `("BBB+","BB+")`, `("AAA","CCC-")`.
76	
77	- **AC-14 (REQ-03-12, C3):** An upgrade or unchanged rating gives 0: `("BBB","BBB+")`, `("BB+","BBB+")`, `("CCC-","AAA")`, `("A","A")`.
78	
79	- **AC-15 (REQ-03-12, C7, C4):** The confirmed/edited values are what the function uses: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2`; `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2` (no override parameter); no network, file or console I/O; returns a number synchronously.
80	
81	- **AC-16 (REQ-06-02, REQ-03-12, X-wl-rules):** For all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE`, with `d = notchChange(p, c)`: `notchCalculator(p,c).notches === d`; `direction` is downgrade/upgrade/unchanged for `d>0`/`d<0`/`d===0`; `notchCalculator(p,c).wl` is 0 when `d<=1`, 1 when `d=2`, 2 when `d>=3`; `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is 0 when `d<=0`, 1 when `d=1`, 2 when `d>=2`.
82	
83	- **AC-17 (Contract, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md):** `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports exactly `RATING_SCALE`, `notchCalculator`, `notchChange`; `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports exactly `countryRatingChangeWl` and imports `notchChange` from `../ratings/notch.mjs`; neither file imports `node:` I/O modules or writes to the console; `package.json` has no `dependencies`/`devDependencies`; `node --test` exits 0.
84	
85	## Risks and assumptions
86	- The POC example for REQ-06-02 is wrong on the C1 scale; C2 corrects it (AC-5). Intentional difference from the raw POC text.
87	- Two threshold sets on purpose: calculator WL 0 vs Indicator 12 WL 1 for a 1-notch downgrade (C6). A dev might reuse one mapping; AC-16 catches this.
88	- Sign of `notches` was missing (C5 removed); the human decided it: signed like `notchChange`, upgrades negative (AC-9, AC-16).
89	- `-0` risk for unchanged ratings; AC-2 and AC-10 require `+0` via `Object.is`.
90	- Assumption: "trimmed" = `String.prototype.trim()`; inner whitespace is not removed.
91	- Assumption: boxed strings (`new String("BBB")`) are not primitive strings and are rejected with RangeError; not in the ACs.
92	- Assumption: `previous` is validated before `current`; only the error type is contract.
93	- Test files must be `*.test.mjs` under `test/` so `node --test` finds them on Node 18+.
94	
95	## Open questions
96	None. Everything that changes scope or behaviour was settled in readiness.md.
97

3	## Goal
4	Deliver the two Watchlist POC requirements of this slice as pure Node ESM library functions that other POC parts will import:
5	- **REQ-06-02**, the notch calculator helper: previous + current rating -> notch change and resulting WL (Indicator 13 thresholds, C2, C3, C6).
6	- **REQ-03-12**, Indicator 12 (country rating change): WL 0, 1 or 2 from the notch change (C3, C6, C7).
7	
8	Success: the four contract exports exist with the exact names and meanings of the Contract section and readiness; every AC below passes under `node --test`.
9	
10	## Scope
11	- `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports:
12	  - `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 C1 ratings, best first, frozen (X-scale-shape).
13	  - `notchChange(previous, current)`: signed integer, positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged.
14	  - `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: `{ notches, direction, wl }`; `notches` signed like `notchChange` (CON-interface, human decision); `wl` per Indicator 13 thresholds (X-wl-rules).
15	- `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)` -> 0 | 1 | 2, built on `notchChange` (imported from `../ratings/notch.mjs`).
16	- Input validation on all three functions: trimmed, case-insensitive match against the C1 scale; anything else throws `RangeError` (C1, CON-errors).
17	- Dev unit tests in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs`.
18	- QA integration tests through the public exports under `test/integration/ratings/` and `test/integration/indicators/` (TST-strategy).
19	- Tests use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.
20	
21	## Out of scope
22	- Fetching or pre-filling the country rating from a public source (C4).
23	- Override parameter, persistence or audit trail for analyst edits (C7, NFR-audit).
24	- Any UI, CLI, printed or logged output (C8, NFR-observability).
25	- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export; its thresholds live only inside `notchCalculator().wl` (X-ind13-scope).
26	- Any other POC requirement or indicator.
27	- Rating notations other than the 19 C1 grades (`Baa1`, `D`, `NR`, `SD`): rejected, not mapped.
28	- npm dependencies, TypeScript, linting, docs or changelog work (ARC-stack, DEL-docs).
29	- The exact RangeError message text; only the type is contract (X-error-message).

31	## Acceptance criteria
32	
33	- **AC-1 (C1, Contract):** `RATING_SCALE` deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]` (length 19, best first); `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true` (X-scale-shape); a non-strict assignment `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` leaves `"AAA"`.
34	
35	- **AC-2 (REQ-06-02, C1, C2, Contract):** `notchChange(previous, current)` returns `index(current) - index(previous)` on `RATING_SCALE`:
36	
37	  | previous | current | result |
38	  |---|---|---|
39	  | BBB+ | BB+ | 3 |
40	  | BBB+ | BBB- | 2 |
41	  | BBB+ | BBB | 1 |
42	  | BB+ | BBB+ | -3 |
43	  | BBB | BBB+ | -1 |
44	  | AAA | CCC- | 18 |
45	  | CCC- | AAA | -18 |
46	  | A | A | 0 |
47	
48	  For A -> A, `Object.is(result, 0)` (not `-0`). Every result is an integer.
49	
50	- **AC-3 (C1):** Valid grades with extra whitespace or different case are treated as canonical in `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl`:
51	  - `notchChange(" bbb+ ", "BB+") === 3`
52	  - `notchChange("aaa", "Ccc-") === 18`
53	  - `notchChange("\tBb+\n", "bbb+") === -3`
54	  - `notchCalculator("bbb+", " bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
55	  - `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+", "bbb ") === 1`
56

Invalid values: `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"` (U+2212), `null`, `undefined`, `3`, `{}`, and a missing argument (`notchChange("BBB")`). Tests check only the error type.
58	
59	- **AC-5 (REQ-06-02, C2):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` (the corrected POC example).
60	
61	- **AC-6 (REQ-06-02, C2):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB-")` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.
62	
63	- **AC-7 (REQ-06-02, C6):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB")` returns `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`.
64	
65	- **AC-8 (REQ-06-02, C2):** A downgrade of 3+ notches gives `wl` 2: `"AAA"->"CCC-"` returns `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`; `"A"->"BBB+"` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` (boundary); `"A"->"BBB"` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.
66	
67	- **AC-9 (REQ-06-02, C3, CON-interface):** An upgrade gives negative `notches` equal to `notchChange`, `direction` `"upgrade"`, `wl` 0: `"BB"->"BBB"` -> `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`; `"BBB"->"BBB+"` -> `{ notches: -1, ... }`; `"CCC-"->"AAA"` -> `{ notches: -18, ... }`.
68	
69	- **AC-10 (REQ-06-02, C3):** The same rating twice: `"A"->"A"` returns `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }` with `Object.is(notches, 0)`; `" a"->"A "` gives the same.
70	
71	- **AC-11 (REQ-06-02, C8, X-scale-shape):** For any valid pair `notchCalculator` returns a plain object whose only keys are `notches`, `direction`, `wl`; `direction` is one of the three words; `wl` is 0, 1 or 2; it is synchronous; each call returns a new object (mutating `r1.wl` does not affect the next call).
72	
73	- **AC-12 (REQ-03-12, C6):** A 1-notch downgrade gives 1: `("BBB+","BBB")`, `("CCC","CCC-")`, `("AAA","AA+")`.
74	
75	- **AC-13 (REQ-03-12):** A downgrade of 2+ notches gives 2: `("BBB+","BBB-")`, `("BBB+","BB+")`, `("AAA","CCC-")`.
76	
77	- **AC-14 (REQ-03-12, C3):** An upgrade or unchanged rating gives 0: `("BBB","BBB+")`, `("BB+","BBB+")`, `("CCC-","AAA")`, `("A","A")`.
78	
79	- **AC-15 (REQ-03-12, C7, C4):** The confirmed/edited values are what the function uses: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2`; `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2` (no override parameter); no network, file or console I/O; returns a number synchronously.
80	
81	- **AC-16 (REQ-06-02, REQ-03-12, X-wl-rules):** For all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE`, with `d = notchChange(p, c)`: `notchCalculator(p,c).notches === d`; `direction` is downgrade/upgrade/unchanged for `d>0`/`d<0`/`d===0`; `notchCalculator(p,c).wl` is 0 when `d<=1`, 1 when `d=2`, 2 when `d>=3`; `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is 0 when `d<=0`, 1 when `d=1`, 2 when `d>=2`.
82	
83	- **AC-17 (Contract, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md):** `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports exactly `RATING_SCALE`, `notchCalculator`, `notchChange`; `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports exactly `countryRatingChangeWl` and imports `notchChange` from `../ratings/notch.mjs`; neither file imports `node:` I/O modules or writes to the console; `package.json` has no `dependencies`/`devDependencies`; `node --test` exits 0.
84	
85	## Risks and assumptions
86	- The POC example for REQ-06-02 is wrong on the C1 scale; C2 corrects it (AC-5). Intentional difference from the raw POC text.
87	- Two threshold sets on purpose: calculator WL 0 vs Indicator 12 WL 1 for a 1-notch downgrade (C6). A dev might reuse one mapping; AC-16 catches this.
88	- Sign of `notches` was missing (C5 removed); the human decided it: signed like `notchChange`, upgrades negative (AC-9, AC-16).
89	- `-0` risk for unchanged ratings; AC-2 and AC-10 require `+0` via `Object.is`.
90	- Assumption: "trimmed" = `String.prototype.trim()`; inner whitespace is not removed.
91	- Assumption: boxed strings (`new String("BBB")`) are not primitive strings and are rejected with RangeError; not in the ACs.
92	- Assumption: `previous` is validated before `current`; only the error type is contract.
93	- Test files must be `*.test.mjs` under `test/` so `node --test` finds them on Node 18+.
94

=== T-01 ===
# T-01: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator in src/ratings/notch.mjs (REQ-06-02)

## What to build
Create `src/ratings/notch.mjs`, a pure ESM module with no I/O. It exports exactly these three names:
- `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 grades from C1, best first, frozen with `Object.freeze` (X-scale-shape).
- `notchChange(previous, current)`: returns `index(current) - index(previous)` as a signed integer. Positive is a downgrade, negative is an upgrade, and the unchanged case is `+0`, never `-0`.
- `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: returns a new plain object `{ notches, direction, wl }` on every call. `notches` equals `notchChange` (signed, per CON-interface). `direction` is `"downgrade"`, `"upgrade"` or `"unchanged"`. `wl` follows the Indicator 13 thresholds: `d<=1` gives 0, `d===2` gives 1, `d>=3` gives 2 (X-wl-rules).

Both functions share one internal normaliser that is not exported. An input is valid only if it is a primitive string that, after `trim()` and upper-casing, equals one of the 19 grades. Anything else throws `RangeError`. `previous` is checked first. Only the error type is contract (CON-errors, X-error-message).

Unit tests go in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.

## User story
As a credit analyst (through the POC modules that import this helper), I want to enter a previous and a current rating and get back the notch change, its direction and the resulting Watchlist level, so that I can see at once how serious a rating move is.

## Traces to
AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 (notch part), AC-4 (notch part), AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, AC-11, AC-16 (calculator part), AC-17 (notch part). Sources: REQ-06-02, C1, C2, C3, C6, C8, CON-interface, CON-errors, X-scale-shape, X-wl-rules, X-error-message, X-ind13-scope.

## Acceptance criteria
1. AC-1: `RATING_SCALE` deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]`, `Array.isArray(RATING_SCALE) === true` and `RATING_SCALE.length === 19`.
2. AC-1: `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true`. `Reflect.set(RATING_SCALE, 0, "X") === false` and `RATING_SCALE[0] === "AAA"` afterwards. Test code is strict ESM, so a plain `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` throws `TypeError` and may also be asserted.
3. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BB+") === 3`.
4. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BBB-") === 2`.
5. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BBB") === 1`.
6. AC-2: `notchChange("BB+","BBB+") === -3`.
7. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB","BBB+") === -1`.
8. AC-2: `notchChange("AAA","CCC-") === 18` and `notchChange("CCC-","AAA") === -18`.
9. AC-2: `Object.is(notchChange("A","A"), 0) === true` (`+0`, not `-0`).
10. AC-2: every result in criteria 3–9 satisfies `Number.isInteger(result) === true`.
11. AC-3: `notchChange(" bbb+ ","BB+") === 3`, `notchChange("aaa","Ccc-") === 18` and `notchChange("\tBb+\n","bbb+") === -3`.
12. AC-3: `notchCalculator("bbb+"," bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.
13. AC-4: with `"BBB"` as the other argument, each of `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB\u2212"`, `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`, in the `previous` position, makes `notchChange` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`.
14. AC-4: the same 13 values in the `current` position (previous `"BBB"`) make `notchChange` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
15. AC-4: the same 13 values in either position make `notchCalculator` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
16. AC-4: `notchChange("BBB")` and `notchCalculator("BBB")` (missing argument) throw `instanceof RangeError`. No call returns a value such as `0`, `NaN` or `undefined` instead of throwing.
17. AC-5: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`. This is the POC example as corrected by C2.
18. AC-6: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB-")` deep-equals `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.
19. AC-7: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`. A 1-notch downgrade gives calculator WL 0 (C6).
20. AC-8: `notchCalculator("AAA","CCC-")` deep-equals `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.
21. AC-8: `notchCalculator("A","BBB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` and `notchCalculator("A","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` (the 2→3 boundary).
22. AC-9: `notchCalculator("BB","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`.
23. AC-9: `notchCalculator("BBB","BBB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: -1, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }` and `notchCalculator("CCC-","AAA")` deep-equals `{ notches: -18, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`.
24. AC-10: `notchCalculator("A","A")` deep-equals `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }` and `Object.is(result.notches, 0) === true`.
25. AC-10: `notchCalculator(" a","A ")` gives the same result as criterion 24, including `Object.is(notches, 0)`.
26. AC-11: for any valid pair, for example `("BBB+","BB+")`, `Object.keys(r).sort()` deep-equals `["direction","notches","wl"]` and `Object.getPrototypeOf(r) === Object.prototype`.
27. AC-11: the result is not a Promise (`!(r instanceof Promise)` and `typeof r.then === "undefined"`).
28. AC-11: given `r1 = notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` and then `r1.wl = 99`, when `r2 = notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")`, then `r2.wl === 2` and `r1 !== r2`.
29. AC-16 (calculator part): for all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE` with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, `notchCalculator(p,c).notches === d` and `Number.isInteger(d)`.
30. AC-16 (calculator part): for the same 361 pairs, `direction` is `"downgrade"` when `d>0`, `"upgrade"` when `d<0` and `"unchanged"` when `d===0`.
31. AC-16 (calculator part): for the same 361 pairs, `wl` is `0` when `d<=1`, `1` when `d===2` and `2` when `d>=3`. Cross-check: the counts are wl0 = 208, wl1 = 17, wl2 = 136.
32. AC-17 (notch part): `Object.keys(await import("../../src/ratings/notch.mjs")).sort()` deep-equals `["RATING_SCALE","notchCalculator","notchChange"]`.
33. AC-17 (notch part): `src/ratings/notch.mjs` has no `import` statements at all. In particular it does not import `node:fs`, `node:net`, `node:http`, `node:child_process` or any other I/O module. It contains no `console.` call and no `process.stdout`/`process.stderr` write.
34. AC-17 (notch part): `node --test test/ratings/` exits 0.

## Edge cases
- Extremes: `AAA→CCC-` = +18 and `CCC-→AAA` = -18 are the largest magnitudes. Neither is clamped.
- Unchanged: every one of the 19 `(g, g)` pairs gives `+0` from both functions, never `-0`. Criteria 9, 24 and 25 check this, and the 361-pair loop should also check it with `Object.is`.
- Trimming uses `String.prototype.trim()` only. Leading and trailing whitespace, including `\t` and `\n`, is removed. Inner whitespace is not removed, so `"BBB +"` is invalid.
- Case folding: `"bbb+"`, `"Bbb+"` and `"BBB+"` are all valid.
- Look-alike characters are not normalised. `"BBB\u2212"` (Unicode minus), `"AAA+"` and `"CCC--"` are invalid.
- Notations outside the scale (`"D"`, `"NR"`, `"SD"`, `"Baa1"`) are rejected and not mapped. `"SD"` comes from the plan's Out of scope, so it may be added to the RangeError list.
- Non-strings (`null`, `undefined`, `3`, `{}`) and missing arguments throw `RangeError`, not `TypeError`.
- Boxed strings (`new String("BBB")`): the plan assumes and the card asks for `RangeError`. This is not an AC, so a test is optional.
- Validation order: `previous` is checked before `current`. Message text (it names `previous`/`current` and quotes the value) is not asserted.
- `RATING_SCALE` must not be mutable by consumers. The returned object is not frozen, but it is fresh on every call.

## Test data
| previous | current | notchChange | notchCalculator |
|---|---|---|---|
| BBB+ | BB+ | 3 | { 3, "downgrade", 2 } |
| BBB+ | BBB- | 2 | { 2, "downgrade", 1 } |
| BBB+ | BBB | 1 | { 1, "downgrade", 0 } |
| A | BBB+ | 2 | { 2, "downgrade", 1 } |
| A | BBB | 3 | { 3, "downgrade", 2 } |
| AAA | CCC- | 18 | { 18, "downgrade", 2 } |
| BB+ | BBB+ | -3 | { -3, "upgrade", 0 } |
| BB | BBB | -3 | { -3, "upgrade", 0 } |
| BBB | BBB+ | -1 | { -1, "upgrade", 0 } |
| CCC- | AAA | -18 | { -18, "upgrade", 0 } |
| A | A | +0 | { +0, "unchanged", 0 } |
| " a" | "A " | +0 | { +0, "unchanged", 0 } |
| " bbb+ " | BB+ | 3 | { 3, "downgrade", 2 } |
| "\tBb+\n" | bbb+ | -3 | { -3, "upgrade", 0 } |
| any invalid value from AC-4 (either position, other = "BBB") | | RangeError | RangeError |

Scale indices: AAA 0, AA+ 1, AA 2, AA- 3, A+ 4, A 5, A- 6, BBB+ 7, BBB 8, BBB- 9, BB+ 10, BB 11, BB- 12, B+ 13, B 14, B- 15, CCC+ 16, CCC 17, CCC- 18.

## Out of scope for this card
- `src/indicators/**` and `countryRatingChangeWl` (T-02), including the Indicator 12 thresholds.
- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export (X-ind13-scope).
- Checking `package.json` dependencies and running the full `node --test` suite (job part of AC-17, done in T-02).
- QA integration tests under `test/integration/ratings/` (QA writes them).
- Asserting error message text, any UI/CLI/logging output, fetching ratings, override, persistence or audit.

# T-02: Indicator 12 countryRatingChangeWl in src/indicators/countryRating.mjs (REQ-03-12)

## What to build
Create `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs`, a pure ESM module with no I/O. It exports exactly one name:
- `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)`, which returns `0 | 1 | 2`.

The module does `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"` and computes `d = notchChange(previous, current)`. It then returns `0` when `d<=0`, `1` when `d===1` and `2` when `d>=2` (Indicator 12 thresholds, X-wl-rules). These thresholds differ from `notchCalculator().wl`. The function must not reuse the calculator's `wl`.

The function has exactly two declared parameters and no override or options argument (C7). It is synchronous and returns a primitive number. Invalid input is handled by the `RangeError` that `notchChange` already throws; the module does not validate again and does not catch the error. `src/ratings/**` must not be modified.

Unit tests go in `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs` and use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.

## User story
As a credit analyst, I want the change in the client's country rating (the values I confirmed or edited) turned into an Indicator 12 Watchlist level, so that a country downgrade raises the client's watchlist signal by the agreed amount.

## Traces to
AC-3 (indicator part), AC-4 (indicator part), AC-12, AC-13, AC-14, AC-15, AC-16 (indicator part), AC-17 (indicator and job part). Sources: REQ-03-12, C1, C3, C4, C6, C7, CON-errors, X-wl-rules, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md.

## Acceptance criteria
1. AC-3: `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+","bbb ") === 1`.
2. AC-4: with `"BBB"` as the other argument, each of `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB\u2212"`, `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`, in the `previous` position, makes `countryRatingChangeWl` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`.
3. AC-4: the same 13 values in the `current` position (previous `"BBB"`) make `countryRatingChangeWl` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
4. AC-4: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB")` (missing argument) throws `instanceof RangeError`. No invalid call returns `0` or any other value.
5. AC-12: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB") === 1`.
6. AC-12: `countryRatingChangeWl("CCC","CCC-") === 1` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA","AA+") === 1` (1-notch moves at both ends of the scale).
7. AC-13: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB-") === 2`.
8. AC-13: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA","CCC-") === 2`.
9. AC-14: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB","BBB+") === 0`, `countryRatingChangeWl("BB+","BBB+") === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl("CCC-","AAA") === 0` (upgrades).
10. AC-14: `Object.is(countryRatingChangeWl("A","A"), 0) === true` (unchanged, `+0`).
11. AC-15: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2` (the analyst-confirmed values are used as given) and `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2`.
12. AC-15: `typeof countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === "number"` and the result is not a Promise.
13. AC-15: `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` imports nothing except `../ratings/notch.mjs`. There is no `node:` import, no `fetch`, no `console.` call and no `process.stdout`/`process.stderr` write.
14. AC-16 (indicator part): for all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE` with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is `0` when `d<=0`, `1` when `d===1` and `2` when `d>=2`. Cross-check: the counts are 0 → 190, 1 → 18, 2 → 153.
15. AC-16 (indicator part): given `("BBB+","BBB")`, `notchCalculator(...).wl === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl(...) === 1`. Given `("BBB+","BBB-")`, the calculator gives `wl === 1` and Indicator 12 gives `2`. This proves the two mappings are separate.
16. AC-17 (indicator part): `Object.keys(await import("../../src/indicators/countryRating.mjs"))` deep-equals `["countryRatingChangeWl"]`, and the source contains `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"` (single or double quotes).
17. AC-17 (job part): across `src/`, the only exports are `RATING_SCALE`, `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl`. There is no Indicator 13 export.
18. AC-17 (job part): `package.json` has no `dependencies` and no `devDependencies` key, and `scripts.test` is still `"node --test"`.
19. AC-17 (job part): `node --test test/indicators/` exits 0, and the full suite `node --test` (or `npm test`) exits 0 at the repository root.

## Edge cases
- The 1-notch boundary is where the two mappings differ: Indicator 12 gives 1 and the calculator gives 0. Any shared threshold table fails criteria 5, 6 and 15.
- The 2-notch boundary also differs: Indicator 12 gives 2 and the calculator gives 1 (criteria 7 and 15).
- Largest moves: `AAA→CCC-` gives 2 (capped at 2). `CCC-→AAA` gives 0 (upgrades never go negative).
- The result is always one of the literals `0`, `1` or `2`. It is never `-0`, `NaN` or `undefined`, and never a negative or unclamped `d`.
- Normalisation and validation come only from `notchChange`. Padded or mixed-case grades are accepted. `"SD"` and boxed strings are rejected with `RangeError` through `notchChange` (plan assumption, not asserted as an AC).
- The `RangeError` from `notchChange` must reach the caller unchanged. It must not be caught, wrapped or turned into a default WL.
- A third argument (for example an override) is ignored and has no effect: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB",2) === 1`. This is optional and supports C7 "no override parameter".

## Test data
| previous | current | d (notchChange) | countryRatingChangeWl | notchCalculator().wl (for contrast) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BBB+ | BBB | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| CCC | CCC- | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| AAA | AA+ | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| BBB+ | BBB- | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| BBB+ | BB+ | 3 | 2 | 2 |
| AAA | CCC- | 18 | 2 | 2 |
| BBB | BBB+ | -1 | 0 | 0 |
| BB+ | BBB+ | -3 | 0 | 0 |
| CCC- | AAA | -18 | 0 | 0 |
| A | A | 0 | +0 | 0 |
| " bbb+" | "bbb " | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| any invalid value from AC-4 (either position, other = "BBB") | | RangeError | RangeError | RangeError |

## Out of scope for this card
- Any change to `src/ratings/**` or `test/ratings/**`. Report defects there; do not fix them.
- Pre-filling or fetching the country rating from a public source (C4).
- An override parameter, persistence or an audit trail for analyst edits (C7, NFR-audit).
- A separate Indicator 13 export (X-ind13-scope) and any other indicator or requirement.
- QA integration tests under `test/integration/indicators/` (QA writes them).
- Asserting error message text, and any UI/CLI/logging output.

---
Notes for Michael:

1	# T-01: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator in src/ratings/notch.mjs (REQ-06-02)
2	
3	## What to build
4	Create `src/ratings/notch.mjs`, a pure ESM module with no I/O. It exports exactly these three names:
5	- `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 grades from C1, best first, frozen with `Object.freeze` (X-scale-shape).
6	- `notchChange(previous, current)`: returns `index(current) - index(previous)` as a signed integer. Positive is a downgrade, negative is an upgrade, and the unchanged case is `+0`, never `-0`.
7	- `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: returns a new plain object `{ notches, direction, wl }` on every call. `notches` equals `notchChange` (signed, per CON-interface). `direction` is `"downgrade"`, `"upgrade"` or `"unchanged"`. `wl` follows the Indicator 13 thresholds: `d<=1` gives 0, `d===2` gives 1, `d>=3` gives 2 (X-wl-rules).
8	
9	Both functions share one internal normaliser that is not exported. An input is valid only if it is a primitive string that, after `trim()` and upper-casing, equals one of the 19 grades. Anything else throws `RangeError`. `previous` is checked first. Only the error type is contract (CON-errors, X-error-message).
10	
11	Unit tests go in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.
12	
13	## User story
14	As a credit analyst (through the POC modules that import this helper), I want to enter a previous and a current rating and get back the notch change, its direction and the resulting Watchlist level, so that I can see at once how serious a rating move is.
15	
16	## Traces to
17	AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 (notch part), AC-4 (notch part), AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, AC-11, AC-16 (calculator part), AC-17 (notch part). Sources: REQ-06-02, C1, C2, C3, C6, C8, CON-interface, CON-errors, X-scale-shape, X-wl-rules, X-error-message, X-ind13-scope.
18	
19	## Acceptance criteria
20	1. AC-1: `RATING_SCALE` deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]`, `Array.isArray(RATING_SCALE) === true` and `RATING_SCALE.length === 19`.
21	2. AC-1: `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true`. `Reflect.set(RATING_SCALE, 0, "X") === false` and `RATING_SCALE[0] === "AAA"` afterwards. Test code is strict ESM, so a plain `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` throws `TypeError` and may also be asserted.
22	3. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BB+") === 3`.
23	4. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BBB-") === 2`.
24	5. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BBB") === 1`.
25	6. AC-2: `notchChange("BB+","BBB+") === -3`.
26	7. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB","BBB+") === -1`.
27	8. AC-2: `notchChange("AAA","CCC-") === 18` and `notchChange("CCC-","AAA") === -18`.
28	9. AC-2: `Object.is(notchChange("A","A"), 0) === true` (`+0`, not `-0`).
29	10. AC-2: every result in criteria 3–9 satisfies `Number.isInteger(result) === true`.
30	11. AC-3: `notchChange(" bbb+ ","BB+") === 3`, `notchChange("aaa","Ccc-") === 18` and `notchChange("\tBb+\n","bbb+") === -3`.
31	12. AC-3: `notchCalculator("bbb+"," bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.
32	13. AC-4: with `"BBB"` as the other argument, each of `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"`, `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`, in the `previous` position, makes `notchChange` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`.
33	14. AC-4: the same 13 values in the `current` position (previous `"BBB"`) make `notchChange` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
34	15. AC-4: the same 13 values in either position make `notchCalculator` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
35	16. AC-4: `notchChange("BBB")` and `notchCalculator("BBB")` (missing argument) throw `instanceof RangeError`. No call returns a value such as `0`, `NaN` or `undefined` instead of throwing.
36	17. AC-5: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`. This is the POC example as corrected by C2.
37	18. AC-6: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB-")` deep-equals `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.
38	19. AC-7: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`. A 1-notch downgrade gives calculator WL 0 (C6).
39	20. AC-8: `notchCalculator("AAA","CCC-")` deep-equals `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.
40	21. AC-8: `notchCalculator("A","BBB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` and `notchCalculator("A","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` (the 2→3 boundary).
41	22. AC-9: `notchCalculator("BB","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`.
42	23. AC-9: `notchCalculator("BBB","BBB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: -1, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }` and `notchCalculator("CCC-","AAA")` deep-equals `{ notches: -18, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`.
43	24. AC-10: `notchCalculator("A","A")` deep-equals `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }` and `Object.is(result.notches, 0) === true`.
44	25. AC-10: `notchCalculator(" a","A ")` gives the same result as criterion 24, including `Object.is(notches, 0)`.
45	26. AC-11: for any valid pair, for example `("BBB+","BB+")`, `Object.keys(r).sort()` deep-equals `["direction","notches","wl"]` and `Object.getPrototypeOf(r) === Object.prototype`.
46	27. AC-11: the result is not a Promise (`!(r instanceof Promise)` and `typeof r.then === "undefined"`).
47	28. AC-11: given `r1 = notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` and then `r1.wl = 99`, when `r2 = notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")`, then `r2.wl === 2` and `r1 !== r2`.
48	29. AC-16 (calculator part): for all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE` with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, `notchCalculator(p,c).notches === d` and `Number.isInteger(d)`.
49	30. AC-16 (calculator part): for the same 361 pairs, `direction` is `"downgrade"` when `d>0`, `"upgrade"` when `d<0` and `"unchanged"` when `d===0`.
50	31. AC-16 (calculator part): for the same 361 pairs, `wl` is `0` when `d<=1`, `1` when `d===2` and `2` when `d>=3`. Cross-check: the counts are wl0 = 208, wl1 = 17, wl2 = 136.
51	32. AC-17 (notch part): `Object.keys(await import("../../src/ratings/notch.mjs")).sort()` deep-equals `["RATING_SCALE","notchCalculator","notchChange"]`.
52	33. AC-17 (notch part): `src/ratings/notch.mjs` has no `import` statements at all. In particular it does not import `node:fs`, `node:net`, `node:http`, `node:child_process` or any other I/O module. It contains no `console.` call and no `process.stdout`/`process.stderr` write.
53	34. AC-17 (notch part): `node --test test/ratings/` exits 0.
54	
55	## Edge cases
56	- Extremes: `AAA→CCC-` = +18 and `CCC-→AAA` = -18 are the largest magnitudes. Neither is clamped.
57	- Unchanged: every one of the 19 `(g, g)` pairs gives `+0` from both functions, never `-0`. Criteria 9, 24 and 25 check this, and the 361-pair loop should also check it with `Object.is`.
58	- Trimming uses `String.prototype.trim()` only. Inner whitespace is not removed, so `"BBB +"` is invalid.
59	- Case folding: `"bbb+"`, `"Bbb+"` and `"BBB+"` are all valid.
60	- Look-alike characters are not normalised. `"BBB−"` (Unicode minus), `"AAA+"` and `"CCC--"` are invalid.
61	- Notations outside the scale (`"D"`, `"NR"`, `"SD"`, `"Baa1"`) are rejected and not mapped.
62	- Non-strings (`null`, `undefined`, `3`, `{}`) and missing arguments throw `RangeError`, not `TypeError`.
63	- Boxed strings (`new String("BBB")`): `RangeError`. Not an AC, a test is optional.
64	- Validation order: `previous` is checked before `current`. Message text is not asserted.
65	- `RATING_SCALE` must not be mutable by consumers. The returned object is not frozen, but it is fresh on every call.
66

68	| previous | current | notchChange | notchCalculator |

77	| BB | BBB | -3 | { -3, "upgrade", 0 } |
78	| BBB | BBB+ | -1 | { -1, "upgrade", 0 } |
79	| CCC- | AAA | -18 | { -18, "upgrade", 0 } |
80	| A | A | +0 | { +0, "unchanged", 0 } |
81	| " a" | "A " | +0 | { +0, "unchanged", 0 } |
82	| " bbb+ " | BB+ | 3 | { 3, "downgrade", 2 } |
83	| "\tBb+\n" | bbb+ | -3 | { -3, "upgrade", 0 } |
84	| any invalid value from AC-4 (either position, other = "BBB") | | RangeError | RangeError |
85	
86	Scale indices: AAA 0, AA+ 1, AA 2, AA- 3, A+ 4, A 5, A- 6, BBB+ 7, BBB 8, BBB- 9, BB+ 10, BB 11, BB- 12, B+ 13, B 14, B- 15, CCC+ 16, CCC 17, CCC- 18.
87	
88	## Out of scope for this card
89	- `src/indicators/**` and `countryRatingChangeWl` (T-02).
90	- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export (X-ind13-scope).
91	- Checking `package.json` dependencies and running the full `node --test` suite (job part of AC-17, done in T-02).

1	# T-01: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator in src/ratings/notch.mjs (REQ-06-02)
2	
3	## What to build
4	Create `src/ratings/notch.mjs`, a pure ESM module with no I/O. It exports exactly these three names:
5	- `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 grades from C1, best first, frozen with `Object.freeze` (X-scale-shape).
6	- `notchChange(previous, current)`: returns `index(current) - index(previous)` as a signed integer. Positive is a downgrade, negative is an upgrade, and the unchanged case is `+0`, never `-0`.
7	- `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: returns a new plain object `{ notches, direction, wl }` on every call. `notches` equals `notchChange` (signed, per CON-interface). `direction` is `"downgrade"`, `"upgrade"` or `"unchanged"`. `wl` follows the Indicator 13 thresholds: `d<=1` gives 0, `d===2` gives 1, `d>=3` gives 2 (X-wl-rules).
8	
9	Both functions share one internal normaliser that is not exported. An input is valid only if it is a primitive string that, after `trim()` and upper-casing, equals one of the 19 grades. Anything else throws `RangeError`. `previous` is checked first. Only the error type is contract (CON-errors, X-error-message).
10	
11	Unit tests go in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.
12	
13	## User story
14	As a credit analyst (through the POC modules that import this helper), I want to enter a previous and a current rating and get back the notch change, its direction and the resulting Watchlist level, so that I can see at once how serious a rating move is.
15	
16	## Traces to
17	AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 (notch part), AC-4 (notch part), AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, AC-11, AC-16 (calculator part), AC-17 (notch part). Sources: REQ-06-02, C1, C2, C3, C6, C8, CON-interface, CON-errors, X-scale-shape, X-wl-rules, X-error-message, X-ind13-scope.
18	
19	## Acceptance criteria
20	1. AC-1: `RATING_SCALE` deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]`, `Array.isArray(RATING_SCALE) === true` and `RATING_SCALE.length === 19`.
21	2. AC-1: `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true`. `Reflect.set(RATING_SCALE, 0, "X") === false` and `RATING_SCALE[0] === "AAA"` afterwards. Test code is strict ESM, so a plain `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` throws `TypeError` and may also be asserted.
22	3. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BB+") === 3`.
23	4. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BBB-") === 2`.
24	5. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB+","BBB") === 1`.
25	6. AC-2: `notchChange("BB+","BBB+") === -3`.
26	7. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB","BBB+") === -1`.
27	8. AC-2: `notchChange("AAA","CCC-") === 18` and `notchChange("CCC-","AAA") === -18`.
28	9. AC-2: `Object.is(notchChange("A","A"), 0) === true` (`+0`, not `-0`).
29	10. AC-2: every result in criteria 3–9 satisfies `Number.isInteger(result) === true`.
30	11. AC-3: `notchChange(" bbb+ ","BB+") === 3`, `notchChange("aaa","Ccc-") === 18` and `notchChange("\tBb+\n","bbb+") === -3`.
31	12. AC-3: `notchCalculator("bbb+"," bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.
32	13. AC-4: with `"BBB"` as the other argument, each of `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"`, `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`, in the `previous` position, makes `notchChange` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`.
33	14. AC-4: the same 13 values in the `current` position (previous `"BBB"`) make `notchChange` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
34	15. AC-4: the same 13 values in either position make `notchCalculator` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
35	16. AC-4: `notchChange("BBB")` and `notchCalculator("BBB")` (missing argument) throw `instanceof RangeError`. No call returns a value such as `0`, `NaN` or `undefined` instead of throwing.
36	17. AC-5: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`. This is the POC example as corrected by C2.
37	18. AC-6: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB-")` deep-equals `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.
38	19. AC-7: `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`. A 1-notch downgrade gives calculator WL 0 (C6).
39	20. AC-8: `notchCalculator("AAA","CCC-")` deep-equals `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.
40	21. AC-8: `notchCalculator("A","BBB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` and `notchCalculator("A","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` (the 2→3 boundary).
41	22. AC-9: `notchCalculator("BB","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`.
42	23. AC-9: `notchCalculator("BBB","BBB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: -1, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }` and `notchCalculator("CCC-","AAA")` deep-equals `{ notches: -18, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`.
43	24. AC-10: `notchCalculator("A","A")` deep-equals `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }` and `Object.is(result.notches, 0) === true`.
44	25. AC-10: `notchCalculator(" a","A ")` gives the same result as criterion 24, including `Object.is(notches, 0)`.
45	26. AC-11: for any valid pair, for example `("BBB+","BB+")`, `Object.keys(r).sort()` deep-equals `["direction","notches","wl"]` and `Object.getPrototypeOf(r) === Object.prototype`.
46	27. AC-11: the result is not a Promise (`!(r instanceof Promise)` and `typeof r.then === "undefined"`).
47	28. AC-11: given `r1 = notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` and then `r1.wl = 99`, when `r2 = notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")`, then `r2.wl === 2` and `r1 !== r2`.
48	29. AC-16 (calculator part): for all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE` with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, `notchCalculator(p,c).notches === d` and `Number.isInteger(d)`.
49	30. AC-16 (calculator part): for the same 361 pairs, `direction` is `"downgrade"` when `d>0`, `"upgrade"` when `d<0` and `"unchanged"` when `d===0`.
50	31. AC-16 (calculator part): for the same 361 pairs, `wl` is `0` when `d<=1`, `1` when `d===2` and `2` when `d>=3`. Cross-check: the counts are wl0 = 208, wl1 = 17, wl2 = 136.
51	32. AC-17 (notch part): `Object.keys(await import("../../src/ratings/notch.mjs")).sort()` deep-equals `["RATING_SCALE","notchCalculator","notchChange"]`.
52	33. AC-17 (notch part): `src/ratings/notch.mjs` has no `import` statements at all. In particular it does not import `node:fs`, `node:net`, `node:http`, `node:child_process` or any other I/O module. It contains no `console.` call and no `process.stdout`/`process.stderr` write.
53	34. AC-17 (notch part): `node --test test/ratings/` exits 0.
54	
55	## Edge cases
56	- Extremes: `AAA→CCC-` = +18 and `CCC-→AAA` = -18 are the largest magnitudes. Neither is clamped.
57	- Unchanged: every one of the 19 `(g, g)` pairs gives `+0` from both functions, never `-0`. Criteria 9, 24 and 25 check this, and the 361-pair loop should also check it with `Object.is`.
58	- Trimming uses `String.prototype.trim()` only. Inner whitespace is not removed, so `"BBB +"` is invalid.
59	- Case folding: `"bbb+"`, `"Bbb+"` and `"BBB+"` are all valid.
60	- Look-alike characters are not normalised. `"BBB−"` (Unicode minus), `"AAA+"` and `"CCC--"` are invalid.
61	- Notations outside the scale (`"D"`, `"NR"`, `"SD"`, `"Baa1"`) are rejected and not mapped.
62	- Non-strings (`null`, `undefined`, `3`, `{}`) and missing arguments throw `RangeError`, not `TypeError`.
63	- Boxed strings (`new String("BBB")`): `RangeError`. Not an AC, a test is optional.
64	- Validation order: `previous` is checked before `current`. Message text is not asserted.
65	- `RATING_SCALE` must not be mutable by consumers. The returned object is not frozen, but it is fresh on every call.

80	| A | A | +0 | { +0, "unchanged", 0 } |
81	| " a" | "A " | +0 | { +0, "unchanged", 0 } |
82	| " bbb+ " | BB+ | 3 | { 3, "downgrade", 2 } |
83	| "\tBb+\n" | bbb+ | -3 | { -3, "upgrade", 0 } |
84	| any invalid value from AC-4 (either position, other = "BBB") | | RangeError | RangeError |
85	
86	Scale indices: AAA 0, AA+ 1, AA 2, AA- 3, A+ 4, A 5, A- 6, BBB+ 7, BBB 8, BBB- 9, BB+ 10, BB 11, BB- 12, B+ 13, B 14, B- 15, CCC+ 16, CCC 17, CCC- 18.
87	
88	## Out of scope for this card
89	- `src/indicators/**` and `countryRatingChangeWl` (T-02).
90	- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export (X-ind13-scope).
91	- Checking `package.json` dependencies and running the full `node --test` suite (job part of AC-17, done in T-02).
