# Plan

## Goal
Deliver the two Watchlist POC requirements of this slice as pure Node ESM library functions that other POC parts will import:
- **REQ-06-02**, the notch calculator helper: previous + current rating -> notch change and resulting WL (Indicator 13 thresholds, C2, C3, C6).
- **REQ-03-12**, Indicator 12 (country rating change): WL 0, 1 or 2 from the notch change (C3, C6, C7).

Success: the four contract exports exist with the exact names and meanings of the Contract section and readiness; every AC below passes under `node --test`.

## Scope
- `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports:
  - `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 C1 ratings, best first, frozen (X-scale-shape).
  - `notchChange(previous, current)`: signed integer, positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged.
  - `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: `{ notches, direction, wl }`; `notches` signed like `notchChange` (CON-interface, human decision); `wl` per Indicator 13 thresholds (X-wl-rules).
- `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)` -> 0 | 1 | 2, built on `notchChange` (imported from `../ratings/notch.mjs`).
- Input validation on all three functions: trimmed, case-insensitive match against the C1 scale; anything else throws `RangeError` (C1, CON-errors).
- Dev unit tests in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs`.
- QA integration tests through the public exports under `test/integration/ratings/` and `test/integration/indicators/` (TST-strategy).
- Tests use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.

## Out of scope
- Fetching or pre-filling the country rating from a public source (C4).
- Override parameter, persistence or audit trail for analyst edits (C7, NFR-audit).
- Any UI, CLI, printed or logged output (C8, NFR-observability).
- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export; its thresholds live only inside `notchCalculator().wl` (X-ind13-scope).
- Any other POC requirement or indicator.
- Rating notations other than the 19 C1 grades (`Baa1`, `D`, `NR`, `SD`): rejected, not mapped.
- npm dependencies, TypeScript, linting, docs or changelog work (ARC-stack, DEL-docs).
- The exact RangeError message text; only the type is contract (X-error-message).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1 (C1, Contract):** `RATING_SCALE` deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]` (length 19, best first); `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true` (X-scale-shape); a non-strict assignment `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` leaves `"AAA"`.

- **AC-2 (REQ-06-02, C1, C2, Contract):** `notchChange(previous, current)` returns `index(current) - index(previous)` on `RATING_SCALE`:

  | previous | current | result |
  |---|---|---|
  | BBB+ | BB+ | 3 |
  | BBB+ | BBB- | 2 |
  | BBB+ | BBB | 1 |
  | BB+ | BBB+ | -3 |
  | BBB | BBB+ | -1 |
  | AAA | CCC- | 18 |
  | CCC- | AAA | -18 |
  | A | A | 0 |

  For A -> A, `Object.is(result, 0)` (not `-0`). Every result is an integer.

- **AC-3 (C1):** Valid grades with extra whitespace or different case are treated as canonical in `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl`:
  - `notchChange(" bbb+ ", "BB+") === 3`
  - `notchChange("aaa", "Ccc-") === 18`
  - `notchChange("\tBb+\n", "bbb+") === -3`
  - `notchCalculator("bbb+", " bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
  - `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+", "bbb ") === 1`

- **AC-4 (C1, CON-errors, X-error-message):** An invalid value in either the `previous` or the `current` position (the other being `"BBB"`) makes `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`; no fallback. Invalid values: `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"` (U+2212), `null`, `undefined`, `3`, `{}`, and a missing argument (`notchChange("BBB")`). Tests check only the error type.

- **AC-5 (REQ-06-02, C2):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` (the corrected POC example).

- **AC-6 (REQ-06-02, C2):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB-")` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.

- **AC-7 (REQ-06-02, C6):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB")` returns `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`.

- **AC-8 (REQ-06-02, C2):** A downgrade of 3+ notches gives `wl` 2: `"AAA"->"CCC-"` returns `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`; `"A"->"BBB+"` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` (boundary); `"A"->"BBB"` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.

- **AC-9 (REQ-06-02, C3, CON-interface):** An upgrade gives negative `notches` equal to `notchChange`, `direction` `"upgrade"`, `wl` 0: `"BB"->"BBB"` -> `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`; `"BBB"->"BBB+"` -> `{ notches: -1, ... }`; `"CCC-"->"AAA"` -> `{ notches: -18, ... }`.

- **AC-10 (REQ-06-02, C3):** The same rating twice: `"A"->"A"` returns `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }` with `Object.is(notches, 0)`; `" a"->"A "` gives the same.

- **AC-11 (REQ-06-02, C8, X-scale-shape):** For any valid pair `notchCalculator` returns a plain object whose only keys are `notches`, `direction`, `wl`; `direction` is one of the three words; `wl` is 0, 1 or 2; it is synchronous; each call returns a new object (mutating `r1.wl` does not affect the next call).

- **AC-12 (REQ-03-12, C6):** A 1-notch downgrade gives 1: `("BBB+","BBB")`, `("CCC","CCC-")`, `("AAA","AA+")`.

- **AC-13 (REQ-03-12):** A downgrade of 2+ notches gives 2: `("BBB+","BBB-")`, `("BBB+","BB+")`, `("AAA","CCC-")`.

- **AC-14 (REQ-03-12, C3):** An upgrade or unchanged rating gives 0: `("BBB","BBB+")`, `("BB+","BBB+")`, `("CCC-","AAA")`, `("A","A")`.

- **AC-15 (REQ-03-12, C7, C4):** The confirmed/edited values are what the function uses: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2`; `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2` (no override parameter); no network, file or console I/O; returns a number synchronously.

- **AC-16 (REQ-06-02, REQ-03-12, X-wl-rules):** For all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE`, with `d = notchChange(p, c)`: `notchCalculator(p,c).notches === d`; `direction` is downgrade/upgrade/unchanged for `d>0`/`d<0`/`d===0`; `notchCalculator(p,c).wl` is 0 when `d<=1`, 1 when `d=2`, 2 when `d>=3`; `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is 0 when `d<=0`, 1 when `d=1`, 2 when `d>=2`.

- **AC-17 (Contract, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md):** `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports exactly `RATING_SCALE`, `notchCalculator`, `notchChange`; `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports exactly `countryRatingChangeWl` and imports `notchChange` from `../ratings/notch.mjs`; neither file imports `node:` I/O modules or writes to the console; `package.json` has no `dependencies`/`devDependencies`; `node --test` exits 0.

## Risks and assumptions
- The POC example for REQ-06-02 is wrong on the C1 scale; C2 corrects it (AC-5). Intentional difference from the raw POC text.
- Two threshold sets on purpose: calculator WL 0 vs Indicator 12 WL 1 for a 1-notch downgrade (C6). A dev might reuse one mapping; AC-16 catches this.
- Sign of `notches` was missing (C5 removed); the human decided it: signed like `notchChange`, upgrades negative (AC-9, AC-16).
- `-0` risk for unchanged ratings; AC-2 and AC-10 require `+0` via `Object.is`.
- Assumption: "trimmed" = `String.prototype.trim()`; inner whitespace is not removed.
- Assumption: boxed strings (`new String("BBB")`) are not primitive strings and are rejected with RangeError; not in the ACs.
- Assumption: `previous` is validated before `current`; only the error type is contract.
- Test files must be `*.test.mjs` under `test/` so `node --test` finds them on Node 18+.

None. Everything that changes scope or behaviour was settled in readiness.md.

# T-01: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator in src/ratings/notch.mjs (REQ-06-02)

## What to build
Create `src/ratings/notch.mjs`, a pure ESM module with no I/O. It exports exactly these three names:
- `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 grades from C1, best first, frozen with `Object.freeze` (X-scale-shape).
- `notchChange(previous, current)`: returns `index(current) - index(previous)` as a signed integer. Positive is a downgrade, negative is an upgrade, and the unchanged case is `+0`, never `-0`.
- `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: returns a new plain object `{ notches, direction, wl }` on every call. `notches` equals `notchChange` (signed, per CON-interface). `direction` is `"downgrade"`, `"upgrade"` or `"unchanged"`. `wl` follows the Indicator 13 thresholds: `d<=1` gives 0, `d===2` gives 1, `d>=3` gives 2 (X-wl-rules).

Both functions share one internal normaliser that is not exported. An input is valid only if it is a primitive string that, after `trim()` and upper-casing, equals one of the 19 grades. Anything else throws `RangeError`. `previous` is checked first. Only the error type is contract (CON-errors, X-error-message).

Unit tests go in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.

## User story
As a credit analyst (through the POC modules that import this helper), I want to enter a previous and a current rating and get back the notch change, its direction and the resulting Watchlist level, so that I can see at once how serious a rating move is.

## Traces to
AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 (notch part), AC-4 (notch part), AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, AC-11, AC-16 (calculator part), AC-17 (notch part). Sources: REQ-06-02, C1, C2, C3, C6, C8, CON-interface, CON-errors, X-scale-shape, X-wl-rules, X-error-message, X-ind13-scope.

2. AC-1: `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true`. `Reflect.set(RATING_SCALE, 0, "X") === false` and `RATING_SCALE[0] === "AAA"` afterwards. Test code is strict ESM, so a plain `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` throws `TypeError` and may also be asserted.

6. AC-2: `notchChange("BB+","BBB+") === -3`.
7. AC-2: `notchChange("BBB","BBB+") === -1`.
8. AC-2: `notchChange("AAA","CCC-") === 18` and `notchChange("CCC-","AAA") === -18`.

33. AC-17 (notch part): `src/ratings/notch.mjs` has no `import` statements at all. In particular it does not import `node:fs`, `node:net`, `node:http`, `node:child_process` or any other I/O module. It contains no `console.` call and no `process.stdout`/`process.stderr` write.
34. AC-17 (notch part): `node --test test/ratings/` exits 0.

## Edge cases
- Extremes: `AAA→CCC-` = +18 and `CCC-→AAA` = -18 are the largest magnitudes. Neither is clamped.
- Unchanged: every one of the 19 `(g, g)` pairs gives `+0` from both functions, never `-0`. Criteria 9, 24 and 25 check this, and the 361-pair loop should also check it with `Object.is`.
- Trimming uses `String.prototype.trim()` only. Inner whitespace is not removed, so `"BBB +"` is invalid.
- Case folding: `"bbb+"`, `"Bbb+"` and `"BBB+"` are all valid.
- Look-alike characters are not normalised. `"BBB−"` (Unicode minus), `"AAA+"` and `"CCC--"` are invalid.
- Notations outside the scale (`"D"`, `"NR"`, `"SD"`, `"Baa1"`) are rejected and not mapped.
- Non-strings (`null`, `undefined`, `3`, `{}`) and missing arguments throw `RangeError`, not `TypeError`.
- Boxed strings (`new String("BBB")`): `RangeError`. Not an AC, a test is optional.
- Validation order: `previous` is checked before `current`. Message text is not asserted.
- `RATING_SCALE` must not be mutable by consumers. The returned object is not frozen, but it is fresh on every call.

1	# T-02: Indicator 12 countryRatingChangeWl in src/indicators/countryRating.mjs (REQ-03-12)
2	
3	## What to build
4	Create `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs`, a pure ESM module with no I/O. It exports exactly one name:
5	- `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)`, which returns `0 | 1 | 2`.
6	
7	The module does `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"` and computes `d = notchChange(previous, current)`. It then returns `0` when `d<=0`, `1` when `d===1` and `2` when `d>=2` (Indicator 12 thresholds, X-wl-rules). These thresholds differ from `notchCalculator().wl`. The function must not reuse the calculator's `wl`.
8	
9	The function has exactly two declared parameters and no override or options argument (C7). It is synchronous and returns a primitive number. Invalid input is handled by the `RangeError` that `notchChange` already throws; the module does not validate again and does not catch the error. `src/ratings/**` must not be modified.
10	
11	Unit tests go in `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs` and use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.
12	
13	## User story
14	As a credit analyst, I want the change in the client's country rating (the values I confirmed or edited) turned into an Indicator 12 Watchlist level, so that a country downgrade raises the client's watchlist signal by the agreed amount.
15	
16	## Traces to
17	AC-3 (indicator part), AC-4 (indicator part), AC-12, AC-13, AC-14, AC-15, AC-16 (indicator part), AC-17 (indicator and job part). Sources: REQ-03-12, C1, C3, C4, C6, C7, CON-errors, X-wl-rules, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md.
18	
19	## Acceptance criteria
20	1. AC-3: `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+","bbb ") === 1`.
21	2. AC-4: with `"BBB"` as the other argument, each of `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"`, `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`, in the `previous` position, makes `countryRatingChangeWl` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`.
22	3. AC-4: the same 13 values in the `current` position (previous `"BBB"`) make `countryRatingChangeWl` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
23	4. AC-4: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB")` (missing argument) throws `instanceof RangeError`. No invalid call returns `0` or any other value.
24	5. AC-12: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB") === 1`.
25	6. AC-12: `countryRatingChangeWl("CCC","CCC-") === 1` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA","AA+") === 1` (1-notch moves at both ends of the scale).
26	7. AC-13: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB-") === 2`.
27	8. AC-13: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA","CCC-") === 2`.
28	9. AC-14: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB","BBB+") === 0`, `countryRatingChangeWl("BB+","BBB+") === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl("CCC-","AAA") === 0` (upgrades).
29	10. AC-14: `Object.is(countryRatingChangeWl("A","A"), 0) === true` (unchanged, `+0`).
30	11. AC-15: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2` (the analyst-confirmed values are used as given) and `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2`.
31	12. AC-15: `typeof countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === "number"` and the result is not a Promise.
32	13. AC-15: `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` imports nothing except `../ratings/notch.mjs`. There is no `node:` import, no `fetch`, no `console.` call and no `process.stdout`/`process.stderr` write.
33	14. AC-16 (indicator part): for all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE` with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is `0` when `d<=0`, `1` when `d===1` and `2` when `d>=2`. Cross-check: the counts are 0 → 190, 1 → 18, 2 → 153.
34	15. AC-16 (indicator part): given `("BBB+","BBB")`, `notchCalculator(...).wl === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl(...) === 1`. Given `("BBB+","BBB-")`, the calculator gives `wl === 1` and Indicator 12 gives `2`. This proves the two mappings are separate.
35	16. AC-17 (indicator part): `Object.keys(await import("../../src/indicators/countryRating.mjs"))` deep-equals `["countryRatingChangeWl"]`, and the source contains `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"` (single or double quotes).
36	17. AC-17 (job part): across `src/`, the only exports are `RATING_SCALE`, `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl`. There is no Indicator 13 export.
37	18. AC-17 (job part): `package.json` has no `dependencies` and no `devDependencies` key, and `scripts.test` is still `"node --test"`.
38	19. AC-17 (job part): `node --test test/indicators/` exits 0, and the full suite `node --test` (or `npm test`) exits 0 at the repository root.
39	
40	## Edge cases
41	- The 1-notch boundary is where the two mappings differ: Indicator 12 gives 1 and the calculator gives 0. Any shared threshold table fails criteria 5, 6 and 15.
42	- The 2-notch boundary also differs: Indicator 12 gives 2 and the calculator gives 1 (criteria 7 and 15).
43	- Largest moves: `AAA→CCC-` gives 2 (capped). `CCC-→AAA` gives 0.
44	- The result is always one of the literals `0`, `1` or `2`; never `-0`, `NaN`, `undefined`, or an unclamped `d`.
45	- Normalisation and validation come only from `notchChange`. `"SD"` and boxed strings are rejected with `RangeError` through `notchChange` (not asserted as an AC).
46	- The `RangeError` from `notchChange` must reach the caller unchanged: not caught, wrapped or turned into a default WL.
47	- A third argument is ignored: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB",2) === 1` (optional; supports C7).
48	
49	## Test data
50	| previous | current | d (notchChange) | countryRatingChangeWl | notchCalculator().wl (for contrast) |
51	|---|---|---|---|---|
52	| BBB+ | BBB | 1 | 1 | 0 |
53	| CCC | CCC- | 1 | 1 | 0 |
54	| AAA | AA+ | 1 | 1 | 0 |
55	| BBB+ | BBB- | 2 | 2 | 1 |
56	| BBB+ | BB+ | 3 | 2 | 2 |
57	| AAA | CCC- | 18 | 2 | 2 |
58	| BBB | BBB+ | -1 | 0 | 0 |
59	| BB+ | BBB+ | -3 | 0 | 0 |
60	| CCC- | AAA | -18 | 0 | 0 |
61	| A | A | 0 | +0 | 0 |
62	| " bbb+" | "bbb " | 1 | 1 | 0 |
63	| any invalid value from AC-4 (either position, other = "BBB") | | RangeError | RangeError | RangeError |
64	
65	## Out of scope for this card
66	- Any change to `src/ratings/**` or `test/ratings/**`. Report defects there; do not fix them.
67	- Pre-filling or fetching the country rating from a public source (C4).
68	- An override parameter, persistence or an audit trail (C7, NFR-audit).
69	- A separate Indicator 13 export (X-ind13-scope) and any other indicator or requirement.
70	- QA integration tests under `test/integration/indicators/` (QA writes them).
71	- Asserting error message text, and any UI/CLI/logging output.
72

1	# T-02: Indicator 12 countryRatingChangeWl in src/indicators/countryRating.mjs (REQ-03-12)
2	
3	## What to build
4	Create `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs`, a pure ESM module with no I/O. It exports exactly one name:
5	- `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)`, which returns `0 | 1 | 2`.
6	
7	The module does `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"` and computes `d = notchChange(previous, current)`. It then returns `0` when `d<=0`, `1` when `d===1` and `2` when `d>=2` (Indicator 12 thresholds, X-wl-rules). These thresholds differ from `notchCalculator().wl`. The function must not reuse the calculator's `wl`.
8	
9	The function has exactly two declared parameters and no override or options argument (C7). It is synchronous and returns a primitive number. Invalid input is handled by the `RangeError` that `notchChange` already throws; the module does not validate again and does not catch the error. `src/ratings/**` must not be modified.
10	
11	Unit tests go in `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs` and use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.
12	
13	## User story
14	As a credit analyst, I want the change in the client's country rating (the values I confirmed or edited) turned into an Indicator 12 Watchlist level, so that a country downgrade raises the client's watchlist signal by the agreed amount.
15	
16	## Traces to
17	AC-3 (indicator part), AC-4 (indicator part), AC-12, AC-13, AC-14, AC-15, AC-16 (indicator part), AC-17 (indicator and job part). Sources: REQ-03-12, C1, C3, C4, C6, C7, CON-errors, X-wl-rules, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md.
18	
19	## Acceptance criteria
20	1. AC-3: `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+","bbb ") === 1`.
21	2. AC-4: with `"BBB"` as the other argument, each of `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"`, `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`, in the `previous` position, makes `countryRatingChangeWl` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`.
22	3. AC-4: the same 13 values in the `current` position (previous `"BBB"`) make `countryRatingChangeWl` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
23	4. AC-4: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB")` (missing argument) throws `instanceof RangeError`. No invalid call returns `0` or any other value.
24	5. AC-12: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB") === 1`.
25	6. AC-12: `countryRatingChangeWl("CCC","CCC-") === 1` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA","AA+") === 1` (1-notch moves at both ends of the scale).
26	7. AC-13: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB-") === 2`.
27	8. AC-13: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA","CCC-") === 2`.
28	9. AC-14: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB","BBB+") === 0`, `countryRatingChangeWl("BB+","BBB+") === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl("CCC-","AAA") === 0` (upgrades).
29	10. AC-14: `Object.is(countryRatingChangeWl("A","A"), 0) === true` (unchanged, `+0`).
30	11. AC-15: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2` (the analyst-confirmed values are used as given) and `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2`.
31	12. AC-15: `typeof countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === "number"` and the result is not a Promise.
32	13. AC-15: `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` imports nothing except `../ratings/notch.mjs`. There is no `node:` import, no `fetch`, no `console.` call and no `process.stdout`/`process.stderr` write.
33	14. AC-16 (indicator part): for all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE` with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is `0` when `d<=0`, `1` when `d===1` and `2` when `d>=2`. Cross-check: the counts are 0 → 190, 1 → 18, 2 → 153.
34	15. AC-16 (indicator part): given `("BBB+","BBB")`, `notchCalculator(...).wl === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl(...) === 1`. Given `("BBB+","BBB-")`, the calculator gives `wl === 1` and Indicator 12 gives `2`. This proves the two mappings are separate.

# T-02: Indicator 12 countryRatingChangeWl in src/indicators/countryRating.mjs (REQ-03-12)

## What to build
Create `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs`, a pure ESM module with no I/O. It exports exactly one name:
- `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)`, which returns `0 | 1 | 2`.

The module does `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"` and computes `d = notchChange(previous, current)`. It then returns `0` when `d<=0`, `1` when `d===1` and `2` when `d>=2` (Indicator 12 thresholds, X-wl-rules). These thresholds differ from `notchCalculator().wl`. The function must not reuse the calculator's `wl`.

The function has exactly two declared parameters and no override or options argument (C7). It is synchronous and returns a primitive number. Invalid input is handled by the `RangeError` that `notchChange` already throws; the module does not validate again and does not catch the error. `src/ratings/**` must not be modified.

Unit tests go in `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs` and use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.

## User story
As a credit analyst, I want the change in the client's country rating (the values I confirmed or edited) turned into an Indicator 12 Watchlist level, so that a country downgrade raises the client's watchlist signal by the agreed amount.

## Traces to
AC-3 (indicator part), AC-4 (indicator part), AC-12, AC-13, AC-14, AC-15, AC-16 (indicator part), AC-17 (indicator and job part). Sources: REQ-03-12, C1, C3, C4, C6, C7, CON-errors, X-wl-rules, X-ind13-scope, ARC-stack, CLAUDE.md.

## Acceptance criteria
1. AC-3: `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+","bbb ") === 1`.
2. AC-4: with `"BBB"` as the other argument, each of `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"`, `null`, `undefined`, `3` and `{}`, in the `previous` position, makes `countryRatingChangeWl` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`.
3. AC-4: the same 13 values in the `current` position (previous `"BBB"`) make `countryRatingChangeWl` throw `instanceof RangeError`.
4. AC-4: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB")` (missing argument) throws `instanceof RangeError`. No invalid call returns `0` or any other value.
5. AC-12: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB") === 1`.
6. AC-12: `countryRatingChangeWl("CCC","CCC-") === 1` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA","AA+") === 1` (1-notch moves at both ends of the scale).
7. AC-13: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB-") === 2`.
8. AC-13: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA","CCC-") === 2`.
9. AC-14: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB","BBB+") === 0`, `countryRatingChangeWl("BB+","BBB+") === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl("CCC-","AAA") === 0` (upgrades).
10. AC-14: `Object.is(countryRatingChangeWl("A","A"), 0) === true` (unchanged, `+0`).
11. AC-15: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === 2` (the analyst-confirmed values are used as given) and `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2`.
12. AC-15: `typeof countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BB+") === "number"` and the result is not a Promise.
13. AC-15: `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` imports nothing except `../ratings/notch.mjs`. There is no `node:` import, no `fetch`, no `console.` call and no `process.stdout`/`process.stderr` write.
14. AC-16 (indicator part): for all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE` with `d = notchChange(p, c)`, `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` is `0` when `d<=0`, `1` when `d===1` and `2` when `d>=2`. Cross-check: the counts are 0 → 190, 1 → 18, 2 → 153.
15. AC-16 (indicator part): given `("BBB+","BBB")`, `notchCalculator(...).wl === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl(...) === 1`. Given `("BBB+","BBB-")`, the calculator gives `wl === 1` and Indicator 12 gives `2`. This proves the two mappings are separate.
16. AC-17 (indicator part): `Object.keys(await import("../../src/indicators/countryRating.mjs"))` deep-equals `["countryRatingChangeWl"]`, and the source contains `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"` (single or double quotes).
17. AC-17 (job part): across `src/`, the only exports are `RATING_SCALE`, `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl`. There is no Indicator 13 export.
18. AC-17 (job part): `package.json` has no `dependencies` and no `devDependencies` key, and `scripts.test` is still `"node --test"`.
19. AC-17 (job part): `node --test test/indicators/` exits 0, and the full suite `node --test` (or `npm test`) exits 0 at the repository root.

## Edge cases
- The 1-notch boundary is where the two mappings differ: Indicator 12 gives 1 and the calculator gives 0. Any shared threshold table fails criteria 5, 6 and 15.
- The 2-notch boundary also differs: Indicator 12 gives 2 and the calculator gives 1 (criteria 7 and 15).
- Largest moves: `AAA→CCC-` gives 2 (capped). `CCC-→AAA` gives 0.
- The result is always one of the literals `0`, `1` or `2`; never `-0`, `NaN`, `undefined`, or an unclamped `d`.
- Normalisation and validation come only from `notchChange`. `"SD"` and boxed strings are rejected with `RangeError` through `notchChange` (not asserted as an AC).
- The `RangeError` from `notchChange` must reach the caller unchanged: not caught, wrapped or turned into a default WL.
- A third argument is ignored: `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB",2) === 1` (optional; supports C7).

## Test data
| previous | current | d (notchChange) | countryRatingChangeWl | notchCalculator().wl (for contrast) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BBB+ | BBB | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| CCC | CCC- | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| AAA | AA+ | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| BBB+ | BBB- | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| BBB+ | BB+ | 3 | 2 | 2 |
| AAA | CCC- | 18 | 2 | 2 |
| BBB | BBB+ | -1 | 0 | 0 |
| BB+ | BBB+ | -3 | 0 | 0 |
| CCC- | AAA | -18 | 0 | 0 |
| A | A | 0 | +0 | 0 |
| " bbb+" | "bbb " | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| any invalid value from AC-4 (either position, other = "BBB") | | RangeError | RangeError | RangeError |

## Out of scope for this card
- Any change to `src/ratings/**` or `test/ratings/**`. Report defects there; do not fix them.
- Pre-filling or fetching the country rating from a public source (C4).
- An override parameter, persistence or an audit trail (C7, NFR-audit).

# Plan

## Goal
Deliver the two Watchlist POC requirements of this slice as pure Node ESM library functions that other POC parts will import:
- **REQ-06-02**, the notch calculator helper: previous + current rating -> notch change and resulting WL (Indicator 13 thresholds, C2, C3, C6).
- **REQ-03-12**, Indicator 12 (country rating change): WL 0, 1 or 2 from the notch change (C3, C6, C7).

Success: the four contract exports exist with the exact names and meanings of the Contract section and readiness; every AC below passes under `node --test`.

## Scope
- `src/ratings/notch.mjs` exports:
  - `RATING_SCALE`: the 19 C1 ratings, best first, frozen (X-scale-shape).
  - `notchChange(previous, current)`: signed integer, positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged.
  - `notchCalculator(previous, current)`: `{ notches, direction, wl }`; `notches` signed like `notchChange` (CON-interface, human decision); `wl` per Indicator 13 thresholds (X-wl-rules).
- `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` exports `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)` -> 0 | 1 | 2, built on `notchChange` (imported from `../ratings/notch.mjs`).
- Input validation on all three functions: trimmed, case-insensitive match against the C1 scale; anything else throws `RangeError` (C1, CON-errors).
- Dev unit tests in `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs`.
- QA integration tests through the public exports under `test/integration/ratings/` and `test/integration/indicators/` (TST-strategy).
- Tests use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.

## Out of scope
- Fetching or pre-filling the country rating from a public source (C4).
- Override parameter, persistence or audit trail for analyst edits (C7, NFR-audit).
- Any UI, CLI, printed or logged output (C8, NFR-observability).
- A separate Indicator 13 / REQ-03-13 export; its thresholds live only inside `notchCalculator().wl` (X-ind13-scope).
- Any other POC requirement or indicator.
- Rating notations other than the 19 C1 grades (`Baa1`, `D`, `NR`, `SD`): rejected, not mapped.
- npm dependencies, TypeScript, linting, docs or changelog work (ARC-stack, DEL-docs).
- The exact RangeError message text; only the type is contract (X-error-message).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1 (C1, Contract):** `RATING_SCALE` deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]` (length 19, best first); `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true` (X-scale-shape); a non-strict assignment `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` leaves `"AAA"`.

- **AC-2 (REQ-06-02, C1, C2, Contract):** `notchChange(previous, current)` returns `index(current) - index(previous)` on `RATING_SCALE`:

  | previous | current | result |
  |---|---|---|
  | BBB+ | BB+ | 3 |
  | BBB+ | BBB- | 2 |
  | BBB+ | BBB | 1 |
  | BB+ | BBB+ | -3 |
  | BBB | BBB+ | -1 |
  | AAA | CCC- | 18 |
  | CCC- | AAA | -18 |
  | A | A | 0 |

  For A -> A, `Object.is(result, 0)` (not `-0`). Every result is an integer.

- **AC-3 (C1):** Valid grades with extra whitespace or different case are treated as canonical in `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl`:
  - `notchChange(" bbb+ ", "BB+") === 3`
  - `notchChange("aaa", "Ccc-") === 18`
  - `notchChange("\tBb+\n", "bbb+") === -3`
  - `notchCalculator("bbb+", " bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
  - `countryRatingChangeWl(" bbb+", "bbb ") === 1`

- **AC-4 (C1, CON-errors, X-error-message):** An invalid value in either the `previous` or the `current` position (the other being `"BBB"`) makes `notchChange`, `notchCalculator` and `countryRatingChangeWl` throw an error that is `instanceof RangeError`; no fallback. Invalid values: `""`, `"   "`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"AAA+"`, `"CCC--"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"` (U+2212), `null`, `undefined`, `3`, `{}`, and a missing argument (`notchChange("BBB")`). Tests check only the error type.

- **AC-5 (REQ-06-02, C2):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` (the corrected POC example).

- **AC-6 (REQ-06-02, C2):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB-")` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.

- **AC-7 (REQ-06-02, C6):** `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB")` returns `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`.

- **AC-8 (REQ-06-02, C2):** A downgrade of 3+ notches gives `wl` 2: `"AAA"->"CCC-"` returns `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`; `"A"->"BBB+"` returns `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` (boundary); `"A"->"BBB"` returns `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.

- **AC-9 (REQ-06-02, C3, CON-interface):** An upgrade gives negative `notches` equal to `notchChange`, `direction` `"upgrade"`, `wl` 0: `"BB"->"BBB"` -> `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`; `"BBB"->"BBB+"` -> `{ notches: -1, ... }`; `"CCC-"->"AAA"` -> `{ notches: -18, ... }`.

- **AC-13 (REQ-03-12):** A downgrade of 2+ notches gives 2: `("BBB+","BBB-")`, `("BBB+","BB+")`, `("AAA","CCC-")`.

- The POC example for REQ-06-02 is wrong on the C1 scale; C2 corrects it (AC-5). Intentional difference from the raw POC text.

# T-01: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator in src/ratings/notch.mjs (REQ-06-02)

**Status:** done
**Commit:** see `git log` of branch job/JOB-20261003-2225-rating-notch-calculator-and-coun--T-01
**Attempt:** 1

## What was done

- Wrote `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` first (34 tests). RED run: the test file failed because `src/ratings/notch.mjs` did not exist (module not found). Note: my first RED attempt used the directory form of the verify command, which on Node 22 fails for a different reason (see Open issues).
- Implemented `src/ratings/notch.mjs`: frozen `RATING_SCALE` (19 grades), `notchChange`, `notchCalculator`, with one non-exported normaliser `indexOfRating` (primitive string, trim + toUpperCase, else RangeError naming the argument and quoting the value; `previous` checked first).
- `notchChange` returns `to - from + 0`, so equal grades give `+0`.
- `notchCalculator` returns a fresh plain `{ notches, direction, wl }`. WL uses the Indicator 13 thresholds (d<=1 -> 0, d===2 -> 1, d>=3 -> 2). No threshold table is shared with Indicator 12 (T-02).
- The module has no imports, no console output, and exports exactly the three names.
- GREEN: all 34 unit tests pass, including the exhaustive 361-pair loop (wl counts 208/17/136, `Object.is` check on notches).

## Changed files

- src/ratings/notch.mjs
- test/ratings/notch.test.mjs

## Verify

```text
/usr/local/bin/node (v20.20.0): node --test test/ratings/
# tests 34
# suites 4
# pass 34
# fail 0
```

Also green on Node 22 with `node --test test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and plain `node --test`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, AC-11
- [x] AC-16 (calculator part), AC-17 (notch part: exports, no imports/console)
- [ ] AC-17 `node --test test/ratings/` exits 0: passes on Node 20; on Node 22 (the first `node` on PATH here) the directory argument itself is rejected, see below.

## Open issues / out-of-scope needs

- The verify command `node --test test/ratings/` exits 1 under Node 22 (`/opt/node22/bin/node`, first on PATH) with "Cannot find module .../test/ratings", because Node 22 no longer accepts a directory as a positional argument. It exits 0 under Node 20 (`/usr/local/bin/node`). Plain `node --test` and `node --test test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` work on both. The verify command (and `qa_verify`) would need a file path or glob to be portable; that is outside my scope (card/board).
